We were on the phone with a technical support engineer.

senses.definition_vi: một người được đào tạo để sửa chữa máy móc và thiết bị điện

senses.definition: a person whose job is to control and repair engines, especially on a ship or an aircraft

examples.x: a flight engineer
the chief engineer on a cruise liner

senses.definition_vi: một người có công việc kiểm soát và sửa chữa động cơ, đặc biệt là trên tàu thủy hoặc máy bay

senses.definition: a person whose job is driving a railway engine
senses.definition_vi: một người có công việc lái đầu máy xe lửa

senses.definition: a soldier trained to design and build military structures
senses.definition_vi: một người lính được đào tạo để thiết kế và xây dựng các công trình quân sự

senses.definition: the activity of applying scientific knowledge to the design, building and control of machines, roads, bridges, electrical equipment, etc.

examples.x: The bridge is a triumph of modern engineering.
an engineering firm/company
Train services on Sunday will be restricted because of engineering works.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động ứng dụng kiến thức khoa học vào việc thiết kế, chế tạo và điều khiển máy móc, đường sá, cầu cống, thiết bị điện, v.v.

senses.definition: the study of engineering as a subject

examples.x: a degree in engineering
an engineering student

senses.definition_vi: việc nghiên cứu kỹ thuật như một môn học

senses.definition: to increase or further improve the good quality, value or status of somebody/something

examples.x: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
things that can significantly enhance the quality of your life
The runner says he's never used steroids to enhance his performance.
The new initiative will enhance our ability to respond to threats abroad.
The project was designed to enhance the experience of museum visitors.
the skilled use of make-up to enhance your best features
Printing in this way saves time and greatly enhances productivity.
These latest discoveries have further enhanced our understanding of the origins of the universe.

senses.definition_vi: tăng cường hoặc cải thiện thêm chất lượng, giá trị hoặc địa vị tốt đẹp của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to get pleasure from something

examples.x: We thoroughly enjoyed our time in New York.
Thanks for a great evening. I really enjoyed it.
She seems to be enjoying life in Paris.
I enjoy playing tennis and squash.
I really enjoyed watching the film again.

senses.definition_vi: nhận được niềm vui từ điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be happy and get pleasure from what you are doing

examples.x: They all enjoyed themselves at the party.
The kids all seemed to enjoy themselves.

senses.definition_vi: hạnh phúc và nhận được niềm vui từ những gì bạn đang làm

senses.definition: to have something good that is an advantage to you

examples.x: People in this country enjoy a high standard of living.
He's always enjoyed good health.
Departmental managers enjoy considerable autonomy in the workplace.

senses.definition_vi: có điều gì đó tốt đẹp mang lại lợi ích cho bạn

senses.definition: used to say that you hope somebody gets pleasure from something that you are giving them or recommending to them

examples.x: Here's that book I promised you. Enjoy!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn hy vọng ai đó nhận được niềm vui từ điều gì đó bạn đang tặng họ hoặc giới thiệu cho họ

senses.definition: giving pleasure

examples.x: an enjoyable weekend/experience
highly/really/thoroughly/very enjoyable

senses.definition_vi: mang lại niềm vui

senses.definition: extremely large

examples.x: an enormous house/dog
an enormous amount of time
Current processors can perform an enormous number of operations per second.
Universities are under enormous pressure financially.
young dancers who show enormous potential
Their house is absolutely enormous!

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ lớn

senses.definition: to the necessary degree

examples.x: I hadn't trained enough for the game.
This house isn't big enough for us.
She's old enough to decide for herself.
We didn't leave early enough.
They've been in this business long enough to know what they're doing.
Tell them it's just not good enough.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ cần thiết

senses.definition: to an acceptable degree, but not to a very great degree

examples.x: He seemed pleasant enough to me.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ chấp nhận được, nhưng không quá lớn

senses.definition: to a degree that you do not wish to get any greater

examples.x: I hope my job's safe. Life is hard enough as it is.
Things are bad enough without you having a meltdown.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ mà bạn không mong muốn nó lớn hơn nữa

senses.definition: to be strong or brave enough

examples.x: He was not man enough to face up to his responsibility.

senses.definition_vi: đủ mạnh mẽ hoặc đủ dũng cảm

senses.definition: used to show that something is surprising

examples.x: Funnily enough, I said the same thing myself only yesterday.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy điều gì đó gây ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used to say that an idea or suggestion seems reasonable

examples.x: ‘We'll meet at 8.’ ‘Fair enough.’
If you don't want to come, fair enough, but let Bill know.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một ý tưởng hoặc đề xuất có vẻ hợp lý

senses.definition: to achieve all that is wanted

examples.x: The new legislation is welcome but does not go far enough.
Do these measures go far enough?
Stop it now. The joke has gone far enough (= it has continued too long).

senses.definition_vi: đạt được tất cả những gì mong muốn

senses.definition: quite probably

examples.x: She would be in bed by now, like enough.

senses.definition_vi: khá có thể

senses.definition: used to say that something is so nearly true that the difference does not matter

examples.x: We've been here twenty years, near enough.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó gần như đúng đến mức sự khác biệt không quan trọng

senses.definition: certainly; in a way that cannot be denied

examples.x: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).

senses.definition_vi: chắc chắn; theo cách không thể phủ nhận

senses.definition: used to say that something happened as expected

examples.x: I said he'd forget, and sure enough he did.
‘Stop,’ she said, ‘I can hear something.’ Sure enough, in the distance we could hear the sound of a car approaching.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đã xảy ra như mong đợi

senses.definition: used before plural or uncountable nouns to mean ‘as many or as much as somebody needs or wants’

examples.x: Have you made enough copies?
Is there enough room for me?
I didn't have enough clothes to last a week.
Don't ask me to do it. I've got enough problems as it is.
There was food enough for all.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trước danh từ số nhiều hoặc danh từ không đếm được để có nghĩa là ‘nhiều hoặc nhiều như ai đó cần hoặc muốn’

senses.definition: as many or as much as somebody needs or wants

examples.x: Six bottles should be enough.
Have you had enough (= to eat)?
If enough of you are interested, we'll organize a trip to the theatre.
There was nowhere near enough for everybody.
We've nearly run out of paper. Do you think there's enough for today?

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hoặc nhiều như ai đó cần hoặc muốn

senses.definition: used to say that something is annoying or boring and that you want it to stop
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó gây khó chịu hoặc nhàm chán và bạn muốn nó dừng lại

senses.definition: used when you think that something should not continue any longer
senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó không nên tiếp tục nữa

senses.definition: used to say that you understand a situation and there is no need to say any more

examples.x: ‘He's a politician, remember.’ ‘Enough said.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn hiểu tình huống và không cần nói thêm nữa

senses.definition: used when something/somebody is annoying you and you no longer want to do, have or see it or them

examples.x: I've had enough of driving the kids around.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi điều gì đó/ai đó làm bạn khó chịu và bạn không còn muốn làm, có hoặc nhìn thấy nó hoặc họ nữa

senses.definition: to ask somebody for some information

examples.x: I called the garage to enquire about progress on the repairs.
She enquired as to your whereabouts.
Might I enquire why you have not mentioned this until now?
He enquired her name.
‘What is your name?’ he enquired.

senses.definition_vi: để hỏi ai đó một số thông tin

senses.definition: an official process to find out the cause of something or to find out information about something

examples.x: a murder enquiry
a public enquiry into the environmental effects of the proposed new road
to hold/conduct/launch an enquiry into the affair

senses.definition_vi: một quy trình chính thức để tìm ra nguyên nhân của điều gì đó hoặc để tìm hiểu thông tin về điều gì đó

senses.definition: a request for information about somebody/something; a question about somebody/something

examples.x: enquiries from prospective students about courses
We received over 300 enquiries about the job.
Greetings and enquiries about family members tend to be in the local dialect.
I'll have to make a few enquiries (= try to find out about it) and get back to you.
For further enquiries, please call…
All enquiries should be addressed to the customer services department.
Two men have been helping police with their enquiries (= are being questioned about a crime, but have not been charged with it).

senses.definition_vi: một yêu cầu thông tin về ai đó/điều gì đó; một câu hỏi về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the act of asking questions or collecting information about somebody/something

examples.x: scientific enquiry
The police are following several lines of enquiry.
a commission/committee of enquiry

senses.definition_vi: hành động đặt câu hỏi hoặc thu thập thông tin về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a place where you can get information

examples.x: Ask at enquiries to see if your bag has been handed in.

senses.definition_vi: một nơi bạn có thể nhận thông tin

senses.definition: to improve the quality of something, often by adding something to it

examples.x: The study of science has enriched all our lives.

senses.definition_vi: để cải thiện chất lượng của một cái gì đó, thường bằng cách thêm một cái gì đó vào nó

senses.definition: to improve the quality of food by adding vitamins or nutrients

examples.x: Most breakfast cereals are enriched with vitamins.

senses.definition_vi: để cải thiện chất lượng thực phẩm bằng cách thêm vitamin hoặc chất dinh dưỡng

senses.definition: to make somebody/something rich or richer

examples.x: a nation enriched by oil revenues
He used his position to enrich himself.

senses.definition_vi: để làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó giàu hoặc giàu hơn

senses.definition: to arrange for yourself or for somebody else to officially join a course, school, etc.

examples.x: You need to enrol before the end of August.
to enrol on a course
to enroll in a course
The centre will soon be ready to enrol candidates for the new programme.

senses.definition_vi: để sắp xếp cho bản thân hoặc người khác chính thức tham gia một khóa học, trường học, v.v.

senses.definition: to happen after or as a result of another event

examples.x: An argument ensued.
The riot police swooped in and chaos ensued.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra sau hoặc là kết quả của một sự kiện khác

senses.definition: to make sure that something happens or is definite

examples.x: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.
The book ensured his success.
We must take steps now to ensure the survival of these animals.
Victory ensured them a place in the final.
The system ensures all children equal access to education.
The system ensures equal access to education for all children.
The government needs to ensure (that) workers' rights are respected.
Rent rises were limited in order to ensure that housing remained affordable.

senses.definition_vi: để chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc là điều chắc chắn

senses.definition: to come or go into something

examples.x: Knock before you enter.
Enter Hamlet (= for example as stage directions in the text of a play).
Someone entered the room behind me.
people who enter the country illegally
Where did the bullet enter the body?
A note of defiance entered her voice.
It never entered my head (= I never thought) that she would tell him about me.

senses.definition_vi: để đi vào hoặc đi vào một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to put your name on the list for an exam, a race, a competition, etc.; to do this for somebody

examples.x: Over a thousand children entered the competition.
Irish trainers have entered several horses in the race.
Her mum entered her in the baby contest.
How many students have been entered for the exam?
Only four British players have entered for the championship.
We're having a class quiz and all the children have entered.

senses.definition_vi: để ghi tên bạn vào danh sách cho một kỳ thi, một cuộc đua, một cuộc thi, v.v.; để làm điều này cho ai đó

senses.definition: to begin or become involved in an activity, a situation, etc.

examples.x: Several new firms have now entered the market.
The US entered the war in 1917.
The investigation has entered a new phase.
The strike is entering its fourth week.
She graduated in 2017 with plans to enter the financial world.

senses.definition_vi: để bắt đầu hoặc tham gia vào một hoạt động, một tình huống, v.v.

senses.definition: to become a member of an institution; to start working in an organization or a profession

examples.x: to enter a school/college/university
to enter politics
to enter Parliament (= become an MP)
to enter the Church (= become a priest)
to enter the legal/medical profession

senses.definition_vi: để trở thành thành viên của một tổ chức; để bắt đầu làm việc trong một tổ chức hoặc một ngành nghề

senses.definition: to put names, numbers, details, etc. in a list, book or computer

examples.x: Enter your name and occupation in the boxes (= on a form).
to enter data into a computer
to enter figures on a spreadsheet
You may need to enter this information manually.

senses.definition_vi: để nhập tên, số, chi tiết, v.v. vào một danh sách, sổ sách hoặc máy tính

senses.definition: to say something officially so that it can be recorded

examples.x: to enter a plea of not guilty (= at the beginning of a court case)
to enter an offer

senses.definition_vi: để nói điều gì đó chính thức để nó có thể được ghi lại

senses.definition: to start being used

examples.x: When do the new regulations come into force?
The new law comes into force as from midnight tomorrow.

senses.definition_vi: để bắt đầu được sử dụng

senses.definition: to apply for a place at a school, in a competition, etc. for somebody or yourself

examples.x: Have you entered your name for the quiz yet?
They’ve already put his name down for Eton College.
Have you put your name down for the school play?

senses.definition_vi: để đăng ký một suất học tại một trường, trong một cuộc thi, v.v. cho ai đó hoặc cho bản thân bạn

senses.definition: a company or business

examples.x: He is in charge of an enterprise with a turnover of $26 billion.
state-owned/public enterprises
The grant is available to small and medium-sized enterprises.

senses.definition_vi: một công ty hoặc doanh nghiệp

senses.definition: a large project, especially one that is difficult

examples.x: Have you heard about his latest business enterprise?
a joint enterprise
The music festival is a new enterprise which we hope will become an annual event.

senses.definition_vi: một dự án lớn, đặc biệt là một dự án khó khăn

senses.definition: the development of businesses by the people of a country rather than by the government

examples.x: They provide grants to encourage enterprise in the region.
an enterprise culture (= in which people are encouraged to develop small businesses)

senses.definition_vi: sự phát triển các doanh nghiệp của người dân một quốc gia thay vì của chính phủ

senses.definition: the ability to think of new projects and make them successful

examples.x: a job in which enterprise is rewarded
a man of enterprise
Many hotels are showing enterprise and imagination by staging special events.
I thought she showed great enterprise.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng nghĩ ra các dự án mới và làm cho chúng thành công

senses.definition: to interest somebody or make somebody laugh in order to please them

examples.x: The aim of the series is both to entertain and inform.
Afterwards live bands will entertain the crowd.
Parents can relax while the kids entertain themselves in the outdoor playground.
He entertained us for hours with his stories and jokes.
They learned to entertain themselves with hobbies that required little or no money.

senses.definition_vi: để làm cho ai đó thích thú hoặc làm cho ai đó cười để làm hài lòng họ

senses.definition: to invite people to eat or drink with you as your guests, especially in your home

examples.x: Do you entertain a lot?
The Bradfords always entertained lavishly at Christmas.
Barbecues are a favourite way of entertaining friends.
They entertained us to lunch in their new house.

senses.definition_vi: để mời mọi người ăn uống cùng bạn với tư cách khách của bạn, đặc biệt là tại nhà bạn

senses.definition: to consider or allow yourself to think about an idea, a hope, a feeling, etc.

examples.x: He had entertained hopes of a reconciliation.
to entertain a doubt/suspicion

senses.definition_vi: để xem xét hoặc cho phép bản thân suy nghĩ về một ý tưởng, một hy vọng, một cảm xúc, v.v.

senses.definition: that you enjoy watching, listening to, doing or experiencing

examples.x: an entertaining speech/evening
I found the talk both informative and entertaining.
She was always so funny and entertaining.

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn thích xem, nghe, làm hoặc trải nghiệm

senses.definition: films, music, etc. used to entertain people; an example of this

examples.x: radio, television and other forms of entertainment
There will be live entertainment at the party.
It was typical family entertainment.
It was not something you would watch for light entertainment.
A folk band provided the entertainment.
Local entertainments are listed in the newspaper.
the entertainment industry/business
The show was good entertainment value.

senses.definition_vi: phim ảnh, âm nhạc, v.v. được sử dụng để giải trí mọi người; một ví dụ về điều này

senses.definition: the act of providing people with somebody to interest them or make them laugh

examples.x: Ladies and gentlemen, for your entertainment, we present Magic Man.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cung cấp cho mọi người ai đó để làm họ thích thú hoặc làm họ cười

senses.definition: the act of inviting people to eat or drink with you as your guests

examples.x: a budget for the entertainment of clients

senses.definition_vi: hành động mời mọi người ăn uống cùng bạn với tư cách khách của bạn

senses.definition: a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it

examples.x: Her voice was full of enthusiasm.
The news was greeted with a lack of enthusiasm by those at the meeting.
Bella responded with great enthusiasm.
‘I don't mind,’ she said, without much enthusiasm.
The threat of violence did not dampen the enthusiasm of voters.
I can't say I share your enthusiasm for the idea.
He had a real enthusiasm for the work.
She never lost her enthusiasm for teaching.
He has shown little or no enthusiasm for regulating financial markets before now.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác mạnh mẽ về sự hứng thú và quan tâm đến điều gì đó và mong muốn tham gia vào nó

senses.definition: something that you are very interested in and spend a lot of time doing

examples.x: Reading is one of her many enthusiasms.

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó mà bạn rất quan tâm và dành nhiều thời gian để làm

senses.definition: a person who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it

examples.x: a football enthusiast
an enthusiast of jazz
She was an enthusiast for early Italian art.

senses.definition_vi: một người rất quan tâm đến điều gì đó và dành nhiều thời gian để làm nó

senses.definition: a person who approves of something and shows enthusiasm for it

examples.x: enthusiasts for a united Europe
They are great enthusiasts of the American work ethic.

senses.definition_vi: một người tán thành điều gì đó và thể hiện sự nhiệt tình đối với nó

senses.definition: feeling or showing a lot of excitement and interest about somebody/something

examples.x: an enthusiastic supporter
enthusiastic applause
They gave her an enthusiastic reception.
You don't sound very enthusiastic about the idea.
Party members were less than enthusiastic about the candidates on offer.
She was still really enthusiastic about going to Spain.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện nhiều sự hứng thú và quan tâm đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: including everything, everyone or every part

examples.x: The entire village was destroyed.
You two are her favourite people in the entire world.
the entire region/nation/country/community
The film is perfect for the entire family.
I wasted an entire day on it.
I have never in my entire life heard such nonsense!
The disease threatens to wipe out the entire population.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm tất cả mọi thứ, mọi người hoặc mọi bộ phận

senses.definition: in every way possible; completely

examples.x: The experience was entirely new to me.
That's an entirely different matter.
We're not entirely sure what to do next.
The approach taken will depend entirely on the individual.
The audience consisted almost entirely of children.
I entirely agree with you.

senses.definition_vi: theo mọi cách có thể; hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to give somebody the right to have or to do something

examples.x: You will be entitled to your pension when you reach 66.
Everyone's entitled to their own opinion.
This ticket does not entitle you to travel first class.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó có hoặc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to give a title to a book, play, etc.

examples.x: He read a poem entitled ‘Salt’.
The company launched a huge marketing campaign entitled ‘Buy Blue’.

senses.definition_vi: đặt tên cho một cuốn sách, vở kịch, v.v.

senses.definition: something that exists separately from other things and has its own identity

examples.x: The unit has become part of a larger department and no longer exists as a separate entity.
These countries can no longer be viewed as a single entity.
Hip-hop is a major commercial entity now (= it is a business, not just a type of music).
A corporation is a separate legal entity and it shields you from personal liability for its debts.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó tồn tại tách biệt với những thứ khác và có bản sắc riêng

senses.definition: a door, gate, passage, etc. used for entering a room, building or place

examples.x: the front/back/side entrance of the house
A separate entrance leads to the garden.
At last we reached the entrance of the cave.
Protesters blocked the entrance to the building.
A lighthouse marks the entrance to the harbour.
I'll meet you at the main entrance.
Guards were posted at the entrance.

senses.definition_vi: một cánh cửa, cổng, lối đi, v.v. được sử dụng để vào một căn phòng, tòa nhà hoặc địa điểm

senses.definition: the act of entering a room, building or place, especially in a way that attracts the attention of other people

examples.x: His sudden entrance took everyone by surprise.
A fanfare signalled the entrance of the king.
She made her entrance after all the other guests had arrived.
The hero makes his entrance (= walks onto the stage) in Scene 2.

senses.definition_vi: hành động vào một căn phòng, tòa nhà hoặc địa điểm, đặc biệt là theo cách thu hút sự chú ý của người khác

senses.definition: the right or opportunity to enter a building or place

examples.x: They were refused entrance to the exhibition.
The police were unable to gain entrance to the house.
an entrance fee (= money paid to go into a museum, etc.)

senses.definition_vi: quyền hoặc cơ hội để vào một tòa nhà hoặc địa điểm

senses.definition: the act of becoming involved in something

examples.x: The company made a dramatic entrance into the export market.
her entrance into politics

senses.definition_vi: hành động tham gia vào một điều gì đó

senses.definition: permission to become a member of a club, society, university, etc.

examples.x: a university entrance exam
What are the entrance requirements for this course?
students hoping to gain entrance to college
Entrance to the golf club is by sponsorship only.

senses.definition_vi: sự cho phép trở thành thành viên của một câu lạc bộ, hiệp hội, trường đại học, v.v.

senses.definition: a person who makes money by starting or running businesses, especially when this involves taking financial risks

examples.x: A creative entrepreneur, he was continually dreaming up new projects.
a recent MBA graduate and budding entrepreneur

senses.definition_vi: một người kiếm tiền bằng cách bắt đầu hoặc điều hành các doanh nghiệp, đặc biệt là khi điều này liên quan đến việc chấp nhận rủi ro tài chính

senses.definition: an act of going into or getting into a place

examples.x: She made her entry to the sound of thunderous applause.
The children were surprised by the sudden entry of their teacher.
They block the entry of the virus into the cells.
How did the thieves gain entry into the building?
Efforts to effect an entry to the flooded submarine were unsuccessful.
There are security checks at the point of entry.

senses.definition_vi: hành động đi vào hoặc vào một địa điểm

senses.definition: the right or opportunity to enter a place

examples.x: No Entry (= for example, on a sign)
Entry to the museum is free.
to be granted/refused entry into the country

senses.definition_vi: quyền hoặc cơ hội để vào một địa điểm

senses.definition: something that you do, write or make to take part in a competition, for example answering a set of questions

examples.x: There have been some impressive entries in the wildlife photography section (= impressive photographs).
The closing date for entries is 31 March.
The winning entry will be published in next month's issue.
The sender of the first correct entry drawn will win a weekend for two in Venice.

senses.definition_vi: một mục, ví dụ như một mẩu thông tin, được viết hoặc in trong từ điển, sổ kế toán, nhật ký, v.v.

senses.definition: the act of taking part in a competition, race, etc.

examples.x: Entry is open to anyone over the age of 18.
an entry form/fee

senses.definition_vi: hành động tham gia vào một cuộc thi, cuộc đua, v.v.

senses.definition: the total number of people who are taking part in a competition, race, etc.

examples.x: There's a record entry for this year's marathon.

senses.definition_vi: tổng số người tham gia một cuộc thi, cuộc đua, v.v.

senses.definition: an item, for example a piece of information, that is written or printed in a dictionary, an account book, a diary, etc.

examples.x: an encyclopedia entry
a blog/diary/journal entry
There is no entry in his diary for that day.

senses.definition_vi: một mục, ví dụ như một mẩu thông tin, được viết hoặc in trong từ điển, sổ kế toán, nhật ký, v.v.

senses.definition: the act of recording information in a computer, book, etc.

examples.x: The job involves filing and data entry.

senses.definition_vi: hành động ghi thông tin vào máy tính, sách, v.v.

senses.definition: the right or opportunity to take part in something or become a member of a group

examples.x: countries seeking entry into the European Union
It is extremely difficult for new companies to gain entry into the market.
She applied for entry to Nottingham University.

senses.definition_vi: quyền hoặc cơ hội tham gia vào một điều gì đó hoặc trở thành thành viên của một nhóm

senses.definition: the act of taking part in an activity or becoming a member of a group

examples.x: Things changed forever with the entry of women into the workforce.
That was before the American entry into the war.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tham gia vào một hoạt động hoặc trở thành thành viên của một nhóm

senses.definition: a door, gate or passage where you enter a building; an entrance hall

examples.x: You can leave your umbrella in the entry.
the dramatic entry to the gallery

senses.definition_vi: một cánh cửa, cổng hoặc lối đi nơi bạn vào một tòa nhà; một sảnh vào

senses.definition: a flat paper container used for sending letters in, with a part that you stick down to close it

examples.x: Writing paper and envelopes are provided in your room.
a padded/prepaid envelope

senses.definition_vi: một vật chứa bằng giấy phẳng dùng để gửi thư, có một phần bạn dán lại để đóng

senses.definition: a flat container made of plastic for keeping papers in

examples.x: Each item was tagged and sealed in a plastic envelope.

senses.definition_vi: một vật chứa phẳng bằng nhựa để đựng giấy

senses.definition: used to talk about planning or calculating something in a way that is not detailed, exact or complete

examples.x: We added up our savings on the back of an envelope.
back-of-the-envelope calculations

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về việc lập kế hoạch hoặc tính toán một điều gì đó theo cách không chi tiết, chính xác hoặc hoàn chỉnh

senses.definition: to go beyond the limits of what is allowed or thought to be possible

examples.x: He is a performer who consistently pushes the envelope of TV comedy.

senses.definition_vi: vượt quá giới hạn của những gì được phép hoặc được cho là có thể

senses.definition: the natural world in which people, animals and plants live

examples.x: The government should do more to protect the environment.
to preserve/pollute/harm the environment
damage to the natural environment
protection/destruction of the marine environment
The environment minister expressed concern over pollution levels.

senses.definition_vi: thế giới tự nhiên nơi con người, động vật và thực vật sinh sống

senses.definition: the conditions in which a person, animal or plant lives or operates or in which an activity takes place

examples.x: a pleasant work/learning environment
Hospitals have a duty to provide a safe working environment for all staff.
They have created an environment in which productivity should flourish.
Polar bears are totally adapted to their hostile environment.
We operate in a highly competitive business environment.
The tests were carried out in a controlled environment.

senses.definition_vi: các điều kiện mà một người, động vật hoặc thực vật sống hoặc hoạt động hoặc nơi diễn ra một hoạt động

senses.definition: the complete structure (including hardware and software) within which a user, computer or program operates

examples.x: a desktop development environment

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ cấu trúc (bao gồm phần cứng và phần mềm) mà trong đó người dùng, máy tính hoặc chương trình hoạt động

senses.definition: connected with the natural conditions in which people, animals and plants live; connected with the environment

examples.x: the environmental impact of pollution
Their main objective is to promote environmental protection.
environmental issues/problems/concerns
an environmental group/movement (= that aims to improve or protect the natural environment)
environmental degradation/damage

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các điều kiện tự nhiên mà con người, động vật và thực vật sinh sống; liên quan đến môi trường

senses.definition: connected with the conditions that affect the behaviour and development of somebody/something

examples.x: the environmental factors that affect insect development
The responses of animals to changing environmental conditions are a central issue in ecology.
She is the director of environmental health at the council.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các điều kiện ảnh hưởng đến hành vi và sự phát triển của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a large number of cases of a particular disease or medical condition happening at the same time in a particular community

examples.x: the outbreak of a flu epidemic
An epidemic of measles broke out, and over 200 children died.
In Victorian times, London endured regular epidemics of smallpox and cholera.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn các trường hợp mắc một bệnh hoặc tình trạng y tế cụ thể xảy ra đồng thời trong một cộng đồng nhất định

senses.definition: a sudden rapid increase in how often something bad happens

examples.x: A recent report describes an epidemic of crime in the inner cities.

senses.definition_vi: sự gia tăng nhanh chóng đột ngột về tần suất xảy ra điều gì đó tồi tệ

senses.definition: one part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts

examples.x: The next episode has not yet been filmed.
I watched a few episodes of seasons one and two.
The soap opera is ending after 175 episodes.
I only saw the first episode in the series
It happened in the final episode of ‘Star Trek’.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của câu chuyện được phát sóng trên truyền hình hoặc radio thành nhiều phần

senses.definition: an event, a situation, or a period of time in somebody’s life, a novel, etc. that is important or interesting in some way

examples.x: I'd like to try and forget the whole episode.
One of the funniest episodes in the book occurs in Chapter 6.
It was an episode in his life that he was not proud of.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện, một tình huống, hoặc một khoảng thời gian trong cuộc đời của ai đó, một cuốn tiểu thuyết, v.v. mà có tầm quan trọng hoặc thú vị theo một cách nào đó

senses.definition: a period of time during which somebody is affected by a particular illness or a particular stage of a longer illness

examples.x: an acute episode of pneumonia
All the patients had episodes of unexplained fever.
His former wife suffered with depressive episodes.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian mà ai đó bị ảnh hưởng bởi một căn bệnh cụ thể hoặc một giai đoạn cụ thể của một căn bệnh kéo dài hơn

senses.definition: the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else

examples.x: There is an equal number of boys and girls in the class.
Each side will put in an equal amount of money.
Cut it into four equal parts.
The two countries are roughly equal in size.
One ounce is equal to 28.3 grams.
An area of forest equal to the size of Wales has been destroyed.
legislation to put Gaelic on an equal footing with English
The decision has attracted both praise and criticism in equal measure (= to the same degree).

senses.definition_vi: có cùng kích thước, số lượng, giá trị, v.v. với thứ khác

senses.definition: having the same rights or being treated the same as other people, without differences such as race, religion or sex being considered

examples.x: I believe everyone is born equal.
a society where women and men are equal partners

senses.definition_vi: có cùng quyền hoặc được đối xử như những người khác, không xem xét đến sự khác biệt về chủng tộc, tôn giáo hoặc giới tính

senses.definition: giving people the same rights and opportunities, without differences such as race, religion or sex being considered

examples.x: equal rights/pay
the desire for a more equal society (= in which everyone has the same rights and chances)
The US constitution guarantees equal protection under the law.
The charity's mission is to help provide equal access to education.
the principles of equal treatment and non-discrimination

senses.definition_vi: mang lại cho mọi người các quyền và cơ hội như nhau, không xem xét đến sự khác biệt về chủng tộc, tôn giáo hoặc giới tính

senses.definition: having the necessary strength, courage and ability to deal with something successfully

examples.x: I hope that he proves equal to the challenge.

senses.definition_vi: có đủ sức mạnh, sự can đảm và khả năng để đối phó thành công với điều gì đó

senses.definition: if the conditions stay the same; if other conditions are the same

examples.x: All things being equal, we should finish the job tomorrow.
All other things being equal, the bigger fighter should win.

senses.definition_vi: nếu các điều kiện giữ nguyên; nếu các điều kiện khác giống nhau

senses.definition: having the same advantages and disadvantages as somebody else

examples.x: Can our industry compete on equal terms with its overseas rivals?

senses.definition_vi: có những lợi thế và bất lợi giống như người khác

senses.definition: although the members of a society, group, etc. appear to be equal, some, in fact, get better treatment than others
senses.definition_vi: mặc dù các thành viên của một xã hội, nhóm, v.v. có vẻ bình đẳng, nhưng trên thực tế, một số người nhận được sự đối xử tốt hơn những người khác

senses.definition: a person or thing of the same quality or with the same status, rights, etc. as another

examples.x: She treats the people who work for her as her equals.
Our cars are the equal of those produced anywhere in the world.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc một vật có cùng phẩm chất hoặc có cùng địa vị, quyền lợi, v.v. như người khác

senses.definition: to be better than anything else or anyone else of the same type

examples.x: He is a player without equal.
As a family holiday destination, the seaside has no equal.

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn bất kỳ thứ gì hoặc bất kỳ ai khác cùng loại

senses.definition: the person or thing with the highest status in a group

examples.x: He was regarded as the ‘first among equals’ by the other office clerks.

senses.definition_vi: người hoặc vật có địa vị cao nhất trong một nhóm

senses.definition: to be the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else

examples.x: 2x plus y equals 7 (= 2x+y=7)
A metre equals 39.38 inches.

senses.definition_vi: có cùng kích thước, số lượng, giá trị, v.v. với thứ khác

senses.definition: to be as good as something else or do something to the same standard as somebody else

examples.x: This achievement is unlikely ever to be equalled.
Her hatred of religion is equalled only by her loathing for politicians.
With his last jump he equalled the world record.

senses.definition_vi: tốt bằng thứ khác hoặc làm điều gì đó đạt cùng một tiêu chuẩn như người khác

senses.definition: to lead to or result in something

examples.x: Cooperation equals success.
More knowledge equals less prejudice.

senses.definition_vi: dẫn đến hoặc kết quả là một điều gì đó

senses.definition: the fact of being equal in rights, status, advantages, etc.

examples.x: racial/social/gender equality
We need to ensure equality of opportunity in all areas of work.
the principle of equality before the law (= the law treats everyone the same)
Don't you believe in equality between men and women?

senses.definition_vi: việc bình đẳng về quyền lợi, địa vị, lợi thế, v.v.

senses.definition: to the same degree; in the same or in a similar way

examples.x: Diet and exercise are equally important.
equally good/impressive/effective
This job could be done equally well by a computer.
Everyone should be treated equally.
The findings of the survey apply equally to adults and children.
The birds are equally at home in a woodland or riverside environment.
She may have arrived late or it is equally possible that she never went there at all.

senses.definition_vi: ở cùng một mức độ; theo cùng một cách hoặc một cách tương tự

senses.definition: in equal parts, amounts, etc.

examples.x: The money was divided equally among her four children.
They share the housework equally.

senses.definition_vi: theo phần, số lượng, v.v. bằng nhau

senses.definition: used to introduce another phrase or idea that adds to and is as important as what you have just said

examples.x: I'm trying to do what is best, but equally I've got to consider the cost.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu một cụm từ hoặc ý tưởng khác bổ sung và quan trọng như những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: a statement showing that two amounts or values are equal, for example 2x + y = 54

examples.x: the numbers on the right-hand side of the equation
the equation for a straight line

senses.definition_vi: một biểu thức cho thấy hai số lượng hoặc giá trị bằng nhau, ví dụ 2x + y = 54

senses.definition: the act of making something equal or considering something as equal (= of equating them)

examples.x: The equation of wealth with happiness can be dangerous.

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho một cái gì đó bằng nhau hoặc coi một cái gì đó là bằng nhau (= của việc cân bằng chúng)

senses.definition: a problem or situation in which several things must be considered and dealt with

examples.x: When children enter the equation, further tensions may arise within a marriage.
Money also comes into the equation.
The availability of public transport is also part of the equation.

senses.definition_vi: một vấn đề hoặc tình huống mà nhiều thứ cần được xem xét và giải quyết

senses.definition: to provide yourself/somebody/something with the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity

examples.x: to be fully/poorly equipped
She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
He equipped himself with a street plan.
The centre is well equipped for canoeing and mountaineering.
Rooms vary in size and come equipped with hairdryers, television and telephone.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho bản thân/ai đó/thứ gì đó những thứ cần thiết cho một mục đích hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: to prepare somebody for an activity or task, especially by teaching them what they need to know

examples.x: The course is designed to equip students for a career in nursing.
Here he received the education that would equip him to take his place in society.

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị cho ai đó cho một hoạt động hoặc nhiệm vụ, đặc biệt là bằng cách dạy họ những gì họ cần biết

senses.definition: the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity

examples.x: a useful piece of equipment for the kitchen
Take care when using old electrical equipment.
electronic/communications/computer equipment
military equipment and supplies
office equipment
They have installed state-of-the-art medical equipment to help improve early diagnosis of the condition.
Everyone should bring the necessary equipment for camping in the mountains.

senses.definition_vi: những thứ cần thiết cho một mục đích hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: the process of providing a place or person with necessary things

examples.x: The equipment of the photographic studio was expensive.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình cung cấp cho một địa điểm hoặc người những thứ cần thiết

senses.definition: equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.

examples.x: 250 grams or an equivalent amount in ounces
the price we would pay elsewhere for a broadly equivalent house
Eight kilometres is roughly equivalent to five miles.
The new regulation was seen as equivalent to censorship.

senses.definition_vi: bằng về giá trị, số lượng, ý nghĩa, tầm quan trọng, v.v.

senses.definition: a thing, amount, word, etc. that is equal in value, meaning or purpose to something else

examples.x: Send €20 or the equivalent in your own currency.
the modern equivalent of the Roman baths
Is there a French word that is the exact equivalent of the English word ‘home’?
The pipeline captures about 15 million metric tons of carbon dioxide annually, which is the equivalent of (= has the same effect as) removing 3.2 million vehicles from the roads.
The German ‘Gymnasium’ is the closest equivalent to the grammar school in England.

senses.definition_vi: một vật, số lượng, từ, v.v. có giá trị, ý nghĩa hoặc mục đích tương đương với thứ khác

senses.definition: a period of time, usually in history, that is different from other periods because of particular characteristics or events

examples.x: the Victorian/modern/post-war era
When she left the firm, it was the end of an era (= things were different after that).
a new era of peace
This is the start of a new era of peace and prosperity.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian, thường là trong lịch sử, khác biệt với các khoảng thời gian khác vì những đặc điểm hoặc sự kiện cụ thể

senses.definition: a length of time that is a division of an aeon
senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian là một phần của một aeon

senses.definition: to build something

examples.x: The church was erected in 1582.

senses.definition_vi: xây dựng một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to put something in position so that it stands upright

examples.x: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.
to erect a tent

senses.definition_vi: đặt một cái gì đó vào vị trí sao cho nó đứng thẳng

senses.definition: to create or establish something

examples.x: to erect trade barriers

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra hoặc thiết lập một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of something

examples.x: spelling/typographical/grammatical errors
The report contains some factual errors that must be corrected.
They committed the fatal error of misjudging the weather conditions.
There are too many errors in your work.
I think you have made an error in calculating the total.
A simple error of judgement meant that there was not enough food to go around.
an error of fact/principle
a serious/grave error
a glaring error (= a mistake that is very obvious)
The computer system was switched off in error (= by mistake).
There is no room for error in this job.
His attempts to arrange a party ended up as a comedy of errors (= he made so many mistakes it was funny).

senses.definition_vi: một sai lầm, đặc biệt là sai lầm gây ra vấn đề hoặc ảnh hưởng đến kết quả của một việc gì đó

senses.definition: to realize or admit that you have done something wrong and decide to change your behaviour

examples.x: Will they realize the error of their ways before it is too late?

senses.definition_vi: nhận ra hoặc thừa nhận rằng bạn đã làm điều gì đó sai trái và quyết định thay đổi hành vi của mình

senses.definition: the process of solving a problem by trying various methods until you find a method that is successful

examples.x: Children learn to use computer programs by trial and error.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình giải quyết vấn đề bằng cách thử nhiều phương pháp khác nhau cho đến khi tìm được phương pháp thành công

senses.definition: when a volcano erupts or burning rocks, smoke, etc. erupt or are erupted, the burning rocks, etc. are thrown out from the volcano

examples.x: The volcano could erupt at any time.
Ash began to erupt from the crater.
An immense volume of rocks and molten lava was erupted.

senses.definition_vi: khi núi lửa phun trào hoặc đá cháy, khói, v.v. phun trào hoặc bị phun ra, đá cháy, v.v. bị đẩy ra khỏi núi lửa

senses.definition: to start happening, suddenly and violently

examples.x: Violence erupted outside the embassy gates.
The unrest erupted into revolution.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu xảy ra, đột ngột và dữ dội

senses.definition: to suddenly express your feelings very strongly, especially by shouting loudly

examples.x: When Davis scored for the third time the crowd erupted.
My father just erupted into fury.
The room erupted with laughter.
‘How dare you?’ she erupted.

senses.definition_vi: đột nhiên thể hiện cảm xúc của bạn rất mạnh mẽ, đặc biệt là bằng cách la hét lớn

senses.definition: to suddenly appear on your skin

examples.x: A rash had erupted all over his chest.

senses.definition_vi: đột nhiên xuất hiện trên da của bạn

senses.definition: to become greater, worse, more serious, etc.; to make something greater, worse, more serious, etc.

examples.x: the escalating costs of healthcare
The fighting escalated into a full-scale war.
We do not want to escalate the war.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên lớn hơn, tệ hơn, nghiêm trọng hơn, v.v.; làm cho một cái gì đó lớn hơn, tệ hơn, nghiêm trọng hơn, v.v.

senses.definition: to involve a more senior person in dealing with a problem or complaint

examples.x: If I don't get a satisfactory outcome, I'm going to have to escalate this issue.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến một người có cấp bậc cao hơn trong việc giải quyết một vấn đề hoặc khiếu nại

senses.definition: the act or a method of escaping from a place or an unpleasant or dangerous situation

examples.x: I had a narrow escape (= I was lucky to have escaped).

As soon as he turned his back, she would make her escape.
an escape from a prisoner of war camp

He took an elaborate escape route from South Africa to Britain.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc phương pháp trốn thoát khỏi một địa điểm hoặc một tình huống khó chịu hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: a way of forgetting something unpleasant or difficult for a short time

examples.x: Craig finds escape in dreams.
For her, travel was an escape from the boredom of her everyday life.

senses.definition_vi: một cách để quên đi điều gì đó khó chịu hoặc khó khăn trong một thời gian ngắn

senses.definition: the fact of a liquid, gas, etc. coming out of a pipe or container by accident; the amount that comes out

examples.x: an escape of gas

senses.definition_vi: việc chất lỏng, khí, v.v. thoát ra khỏi ống hoặc vật chứa một cách vô tình; lượng thoát ra

senses.definition: a button on a computer keyboard that you press to stop a particular operation or leave a program

examples.x: Press escape to get back to the menu.

senses.definition_vi: một nút trên bàn phím máy tính mà bạn nhấn để dừng một thao tác cụ thể hoặc thoát khỏi một chương trình

senses.definition: to manage to escape completely

examples.x: He made good his escape from a crowd of journalists by jumping over a barrier.
I found an open door and made good my escape.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng thoát ra hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to get away from a place where you have been kept as a prisoner or not allowed to leave

examples.x: Two prisoners have escaped.
They were caught trying to escape.
He escaped from prison this morning.
She attempted to escape from the pirates holding her hostage.
She managed to escape her captors.
He escaped prison with two other inmates.

senses.definition_vi: thoát khỏi một nơi bạn bị giam giữ hoặc không được phép rời đi

senses.definition: to get away from or avoid something unpleasant or dangerous

examples.x: Although he had no idea what life there would be like, he had to take the chance to escape.
She managed to escape from the burning car.
As a child he would often escape into a dream world of his own.
We were able to escape to the countryside during the summer months.
I escaped with only minor injuries.
Both drivers escaped unhurt.
to escape unharmed/uninjured/unscathed
She was lucky to escape punishment.
They were glad to have escaped the clutches of winter for another year.
The pilot escaped death by seconds.
There was no escaping the fact that he was overweight.
They narrowly escaped being killed.

senses.definition_vi: thoát khỏi hoặc tránh điều gì đó khó chịu hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: to be forgotten or not noticed

examples.x: Her name escapes me (= I can't remember it).
It might have escaped your notice, but I'm very busy at the moment.

senses.definition_vi: bị lãng quên hoặc không được chú ý

senses.definition: to get out of a container, especially through a hole

examples.x: Put a lid on to prevent heat escaping.
toxic waste escaping into the sea

senses.definition_vi: thoát ra khỏi vật chứa, đặc biệt là qua một lỗ

senses.definition: to come out from your mouth without you intending it to

examples.x: A groan escaped her lips.

senses.definition_vi: thoát ra khỏi miệng bạn mà bạn không cố ý

senses.definition: to try to prevent or avoid loss or damage when it is already too late to do so
senses.definition_vi: cố gắng ngăn chặn hoặc tránh tổn thất hoặc thiệt hại khi đã quá muộn để làm điều đó

senses.definition: more with one person, thing, etc. than with others, or more in particular circumstances than in others

examples.x: In some countries, especially poorer ones, healthcare systems are struggling to cope.
I love Rome, especially in the spring.
The car is quite small, especially if you have children.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn với một người, một vật, v.v. so với những người khác, hoặc nhiều hơn trong các trường hợp cụ thể so với những trường hợp khác

senses.definition: for a particular purpose, person, etc.

examples.x: I got up early especially.
I made it especially for you.

senses.definition_vi: cho một mục đích, người, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: very much; to a particular degree

examples.x: A plentiful supply of water is especially important in summer.
especially useful/interesting
Many websites display the date of publication within the URL for the page. This is especially true of blogs and news sites.
I wasn't feeling especially happy that day.
‘Do you like his novels?’ ‘Not especially.’

senses.definition_vi: rất nhiều; ở một mức độ nhất định

examples.x: I have to write an essay this weekend.
an essay on the causes of the First World War
Have you done your essay about Napoleon yet?
He made some very good points in his essay.

senses.definition_vi: một đoạn văn ngắn của học sinh như một phần của khóa học

senses.definition: a short piece of writing on a particular subject, written in order to be published

examples.x: a collection of essays by prominent African American writers
The book contains a number of interesting essays on women in society.
Pierce contributes a long essay about John F. Kennedy.
I discuss this in a forthcoming essay.

senses.definition_vi: một đoạn văn ngắn về một chủ đề cụ thể, được viết để xuất bản

examples.x: His first essay in politics was a complete disaster.

senses.definition_vi: một nỗ lực để làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the most important quality or feature of something, that makes it what it is

examples.x: His paintings capture the essence of France.
In essence (= when you consider the most important points), your situation isn't so different from mine.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm quan trọng nhất của một cái gì đó, làm cho nó trở thành chính nó

senses.definition: a liquid taken from a plant, etc. that contains its smell and taste in a very strong form

examples.x: essence of rose
coffee/vanilla/almond essence

senses.definition_vi: một chất lỏng lấy từ thực vật, v.v. chứa mùi và vị của nó ở dạng rất đậm đặc

senses.definition: necessary and very important

examples.x: In this situation time is of the essence (= we must do things as quickly as possible).

senses.definition_vi: cần thiết và rất quan trọng

senses.definition: completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation or for a particular activity

examples.x: an essential part/feature of something
an essential element/ingredient/component of something
The local government is not able to provide essential services such as gas, water and electricity.
Vitamins play an essential role in many body processes.
The museum is closed while essential repairs are being carried out.
The charity will be taking food and essential supplies to six refugee camps.
This book is essential reading for all nature lovers.
All events are free, but booking is essential.
Money is not essential to happiness.
Experience is essential for this job.

examples.cf: it is essential to do something
examples.x: It is essential to keep the two groups separate.

examples.cf: it is essential for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: It is absolutely essential for all those involved in education to be computer-literate
It is essential that you have some experience.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn cần thiết; cực kỳ quan trọng trong một tình huống hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: connected with the most important aspect or basic nature of somebody/something

examples.x: The essential difference between Sara and me is in our attitude to money.
He describes what he thinks is the essential nature of America.
The essential character of the town has been destroyed by the new road.
The film captures an essential truth of adolescence

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến khía cạnh quan trọng nhất hoặc bản chất cơ bản của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: when you think about the true, important or basic nature of somebody/something

examples.x: There are three essentially different ways of tackling the problem.
The pattern is essentially the same in all cases.
Essentially, what we are suggesting is that the firm needs to change.
He was, essentially, a teacher, not a manager.
The article was essentially concerned with her relationship with her parents (= it dealt with other things, but this was the most important).

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn xem xét bản chất thực sự, quan trọng hoặc cơ bản của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to start or create an organization, a system, etc. that is meant to last for a long time

examples.x: The committee was established in 1912.
They now hope to establish a centre in Cuba.
The company established a base in Florida last year.
to establish a state/government/group/school
to establish standards/principles
Let’s establish some ground rules.
The proposal would establish a system of inspections of prisons worldwide.
They are establishing a network of pumps and pipelines to move the oil.
The new treaty establishes a free trade zone.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu hoặc tạo ra một tổ chức, một hệ thống, v.v. có ý định tồn tại lâu dài

senses.definition: to start having a relationship, especially a formal one, with another person, group or country

examples.x: to establish relations/links/contacts/connections

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu có mối quan hệ, đặc biệt là mối quan hệ chính thức, với người khác, nhóm hoặc quốc gia

senses.definition: to hold a position for long enough or succeed in something well enough to make people accept and respect you

examples.x: He has now firmly established his position in the organization.
The school has established a reputation for academic excellence.
It took him a long time to establish himself.
He has just set up his own business but it will take him a while to get established.
The exhibition helped to establish her as an artist.
By then she was established as a star.
Not long after that she established herself in business.

senses.definition_vi: giữ một vị trí đủ lâu hoặc thành công trong một điều gì đó đủ tốt để khiến mọi người chấp nhận và tôn trọng bạn

senses.definition: to make people accept a belief, claim, custom etc.

examples.x: This success helped to establish the practice of vaccination.
Traditions get established over time.
It was the outbreak of the Second World War that established the tradition of the monarch's Christmas broadcast.
The festival has become established as an annual event.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người chấp nhận một niềm tin, tuyên bố, phong tục, v.v.

examples.x: Police are still trying to establish the cause of the accident.
There will be an investigation to establish the facts.
We are still trying to establish the identity of the dead man.
His guilt has been clearly established.
The effectiveness of the new drug has not yet been scientifically established.
They have established that his injuries were caused by a fall.
We need to establish where she was at the time of the shooting.
It has since been established that the horse was drugged.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá hoặc chứng minh các sự kiện của một tình huống

senses.definition: an organization, a large institution or a hotel

examples.x: The visa is for foreign nationals wishing to study at a university, college or similar educational establishment.
She's now running a small government research establishment.
The hotel is a comfortable and well-run establishment.

senses.definition_vi: một tổ chức, một cơ sở lớn hoặc một khách sạn

examples.x: the medical/military/political establishment
young people rebelling against the Establishment

The British Establishment is/are very slow to accept change.
orthodox Establishment views

senses.definition_vi: những người trong xã hội hoặc một ngành nghề có ảnh hưởng và quyền lực và thường không ủng hộ sự thay đổi

senses.definition: the act of starting or creating something that is meant to last for a long time

examples.x: The speaker announced the establishment of a new college.
His visit facilitated the establishment of diplomatic relations between the countries.

senses.definition_vi: hành động bắt đầu hoặc tạo ra một cái gì đó có ý định tồn tại lâu dài

senses.definition: an area of land with a lot of houses or factories of the same type on it

examples.x: She lives in a tower block on an estate in London.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất có nhiều nhà ở hoặc nhà máy cùng loại

examples.x: a 3 000-acre estate

She receives rent from all the people whose cottages are on estate land.

senses.definition_vi: một khu đất rộng lớn, thường ở nông thôn, thuộc sở hữu của một người hoặc gia đình

examples.x: Her estate was left to her daughter.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả tiền bạc và tài sản mà một người sở hữu, đặc biệt là tất cả những gì còn lại khi họ qua đời

senses.definition: a car with a lot of space behind the back seats and a door at the back for loading large items
senses.definition_vi: một chiếc xe có nhiều không gian phía sau ghế sau và một cửa phía sau để chất hàng hóa lớn

examples.x: to provide/obtain an estimate
I can give you a rough estimate of the amount of wood you will need.

official government estimates of traffic growth over the next decade
a ballpark estimate (= an approximate estimate)

The map is the best estimate from the data available.

examples.x: I asked a couple of local builders for estimates.

We'll send you an estimate for the repairs.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố về chi phí có thể có của một công việc

senses.definition_vi: hình thành một ý tưởng về chi phí, kích thước, giá trị, v.v. của một cái gì đó, nhưng không tính toán chính xác

senses.definition: without an end; existing or continuing forever

examples.x: the promise of eternal life in heaven

eternal truths (= ideas that are always true and never change)
You have my eternal gratitude (= very great gratitude).
To his eternal credit (= very great credit), he never gave up.
Newspapers are simply responding to the eternal fascination of their readers with the private lives of the rich and famous.

senses.definition_vi: không có hồi kết; tồn tại hoặc tiếp tục mãi mãi

senses.definition: happening often and seeming never to stop

examples.x: I'm tired of your eternal arguments.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra thường xuyên và dường như không bao giờ dừng lại

senses.definition: people never stop hoping
senses.definition_vi: mọi người không bao giờ ngừng hy vọng

senses.definition: moral principles that control or influence a person’s behaviour

examples.x: professional/business/medical ethics

senses.definition_vi: các nguyên tắc đạo đức kiểm soát hoặc ảnh hưởng đến hành vi của một người

senses.definition: a system of moral principles or rules of behaviour

examples.x: The ethic of personal achievement is very strong in Western societies.

senses.definition_vi: một hệ thống các nguyên tắc đạo đức hoặc quy tắc hành vi

senses.definition: the branch of philosophy that deals with moral principles
senses.definition_vi: nhánh triết học nghiên cứu về các nguyên tắc đạo đức

senses.definition: connected with beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong

examples.x: ethical issues/standards/questions/dilemmas

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến niềm tin và nguyên tắc về điều gì là đúng và sai

senses.definition: morally correct or acceptable

examples.cf: it is ethical to do something
examples.x: Is it ethical to keep animals in zoos?

examples.cf: it is ethical for somebody to do something
examples.x: It would have been more ethical for him to resign.
ethical investment (= investing money in businesses that are considered morally acceptable)
I don't consider the arms trade to be an ethical one.

senses.definition_vi: đúng đắn hoặc chấp nhận được về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: connected with or belonging to a group of people that share a cultural tradition

examples.x: ethnic background/origin
ethnic strife/tensions/violence (= between different ethnic groups)
Our government should reflect the racial and ethnic diversity of our country.
ethnic Albanians living in Germany
The country is divided along ethnic lines.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến hoặc thuộc về một nhóm người có chung truyền thống văn hóa

senses.definition: typical of a country or culture that is very different from modern Western culture and therefore interesting for people in Western countries

examples.x: ethnic clothes/jewellery/cooking

senses.definition_vi: điển hình cho một quốc gia hoặc nền văn hóa rất khác biệt so với văn hóa phương Tây hiện đại và do đó thú vị đối với người dân ở các nước phương Tây

senses.definition: the unit of money of some countries of the European Union

examples.x: I paid five euros for it.
10 million euro
The price is given in euros.
a 30-million-euro deal
A half-kilo pack of pasta costs around 70 euro cents.

senses.definition_vi: đơn vị tiền tệ của một số quốc gia thuộc Liên minh Châu Âu

senses.definition: euros as a system of money; the value of the euro compared with the value of the money of other countries

examples.x: What if the UK had joined the Euro in 1999?
the value of the euro against the dollar

senses.definition_vi: euro như một hệ thống tiền tệ; giá trị của đồng euro so với giá trị tiền tệ của các quốc gia khác

senses.definition: to move people from a place of danger to a safer place

examples.x: Police evacuated nearby buildings.
Children were evacuated from London to escape the bombing.
Families were evacuated to safer parts of the city.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển mọi người khỏi nơi nguy hiểm đến nơi an toàn hơn

senses.definition: to move out of a place because of danger, and leave the place empty

examples.x: Employees were urged to evacuate their offices immediately.
Locals were told to evacuate.

senses.definition_vi: rời khỏi một địa điểm vì nguy hiểm, và để lại địa điểm đó trống rỗng

senses.definition: to empty your bowels
senses.definition_vi: làm trống ruột của bạn

senses.definition: to form an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully

examples.x: The trial will evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
Researchers evaluated teaching performance by comparing students' exam results.
The study will critically evaluate whether this technology is useful.
We need to evaluate how well the policy is working.
The cheeses are evaluated for flavour, texture and colour.
Candidates are evaluated on their ability to think independently.

senses.definition_vi: hình thành một ý kiến về số lượng, giá trị hoặc chất lượng của một cái gì đó sau khi đã suy nghĩ cẩn thận về nó

senses.definition: the act of forming an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully

examples.x: an evaluation of the healthcare system
The technique is not widely practised and requires further evaluation.
The discussion includes a critical evaluation of the documentary sources.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hình thành một ý kiến về số lượng, giá trị hoặc chất lượng của một cái gì đó sau khi đã suy nghĩ cẩn thận về nó

senses.definition: that can be divided exactly by two

examples.x: 4, 6, 8 and 10 are all even numbers.

senses.definition_vi: có thể chia hết cho hai

senses.definition: equal or the same for each person, team, place, etc.

examples.x: Our scores are now even.
the even distribution of food

senses.definition_vi: bằng hoặc như nhau cho mỗi người, đội, địa điểm, v.v.

senses.definition: equally balanced or of an equal standard

examples.x: an even contest

Until then the match looked fairly even.

senses.definition_vi: cân bằng hoặc có cùng tiêu chuẩn

senses.definition: not changing very much in amount, speed, etc.

examples.x: Children do not learn at an even pace.
Try to keep your baby's room at an even temperature.

senses.definition_vi: không thay đổi nhiều về số lượng, tốc độ, v.v.

senses.definition: smooth, level and flat

examples.x: You need an even surface to work on.
The floor isn't completely even.

senses.definition_vi: mịn, bằng phẳng và không có chỗ lồi lõm

senses.definition: equally spaced and the same size

examples.x: even features/teeth
