senses.definition_vi: cách đều nhau và cùng kích thước

senses.definition: calm; not changing or becoming upset

examples.x: She has a very even temperament.
He spoke in a steady, even voice.
Nothing disturbed the even tenor of our life.

senses.definition_vi: bình tĩnh; không thay đổi hoặc trở nên bối rối

senses.definition: to no longer owe somebody money or a favour

examples.x: If I pay for the meals then we’re even.

senses.definition_vi: không còn nợ ai đó tiền hoặc ân huệ

senses.definition: to cause somebody the same amount of trouble or harm as they have caused you

examples.x: I'll get even with you for this, just you wait.

senses.definition_vi: gây cho ai đó cùng một lượng rắc rối hoặc tổn hại như họ đã gây ra cho bạn

senses.definition: to complete a piece of business, etc. without either losing money or making a profit

examples.x: The company just about broke even last year.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn thành một công việc kinh doanh, v.v. mà không bị lỗ hoặc có lãi

senses.definition: to be equally likely to do or not do something

examples.x: She has more than an even chance of winning tomorrow.
There’s an even chance that the jury will find him guilty.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng như nhau để làm hoặc không làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: no particular person, team, etc. is doing better than the others in a competition, an argument, etc.
senses.definition_vi: không có người, đội nào đặc biệt làm tốt hơn những người khác trong một cuộc thi, một cuộc tranh luận, v.v.

senses.definition: living, working or happening in a calm way, with no sudden changes, especially after a difficult time

examples.x: Business is now back on an even keel after the strike.
Setting her life back on an even keel after their break-up had been incredibly difficult.

senses.definition_vi: sống, làm việc hoặc xảy ra một cách bình tĩnh, không có những thay đổi đột ngột, đặc biệt là sau một thời gian khó khăn

senses.definition: used to emphasize something unexpected or surprising

examples.x: She didn't even call to say she wasn't coming.
He never even opened the letter (= so he certainly didn't read it).
It wouldn't have been possible 30 years ago, maybe even 20.
It was cold there even in summer (= so it must have been very cold in winter).
Even a child can understand it (= so adults certainly can).

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó bất ngờ hoặc đáng ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used when you are comparing things, to make the comparison stronger

examples.x: You know even less about it than I do.
She's even more intelligent than her sister.
The Second World War made things even worse.
We face an even greater challenge today.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi so sánh mọi thứ, để làm cho sự so sánh mạnh mẽ hơn

senses.definition: used to introduce a more exact description of somebody/something

examples.x: It's an unattractive building, ugly even.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra một mô tả chính xác hơn về ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: just at the same time as somebody does something or as something else happens

examples.x: Even as he shouted the warning the car skidded.

senses.definition_vi: ngay tại thời điểm ai đó làm điều gì đó hoặc khi một điều gì đó khác xảy ra

senses.definition: despite the possibility that; no matter whether

examples.x: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp khả năng rằng; bất kể liệu

senses.definition: despite the fact that; even though

examples.x: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp thực tế là; ngay cả khi

senses.definition: despite what has/had happened

examples.x: I've shown him the photographs but even now he won't believe me.
Even then she would not admit her mistake.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp những gì đã xảy ra

senses.definition: at this or that exact moment

examples.x: The troops are even now preparing to march into the city.

senses.definition_vi: ngay tại thời điểm này hoặc thời điểm đó

senses.definition: despite that

examples.x: There are a lot of spelling mistakes; even so, it's quite a good essay.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp điều đó

senses.definition: despite the fact that

examples.x: I like her, even though she can be annoying at times.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp thực tế là

senses.definition: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed

examples.x: Remember to call me this evening.
We haven't spoken to him since yesterday evening.
I'll see you tomorrow evening.
Come over on Thursday evening.
What do you usually do in the evening?
Mosquitoes usually bite in the early evening.
She's going to her sister's for the evening.
on the evening of May 15
He hardly spoke throughout the evening.
We spent many enjoyable summer evenings together.
I found it in the pocket of the jacket I had been wearing the previous evening.
The evening meal is served at 7 p.m.
She watched the evening news at 6 p.m. as usual.
As the evening wore on, Sam became more and more unhappy.
Jim's comedy routine was the highlight of the evening's entertainment.

senses.definition_vi: phần của ngày giữa buổi chiều và thời điểm đi ngủ

senses.definition: an event of a particular type happening in the evening

examples.x: a musical evening at school (= when music is performed)
the school parents' evening (= when parents are invited to talk to teachers about their children's progress)

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện thuộc loại nhất định xảy ra vào buổi tối

senses.definition: a thing that happens, especially something important

examples.x: recent/current/world events
The tragic events of last Monday occurred only 200 metres from the shore.
Historians long ago established that the event never happened.
TV viewers watched in horror as events unfolded.
a dramatic turn of events (= change in what is happening)
Everyone was frightened by the strange sequence of events.
The police have reconstructed the chain of events leading to the murder.
an unfortunate series of events
Why should we believe his version of events (= description of what happened from his point of view)?
The decisions we take now may influence the course of events (= the way things happen) in the future.
In the normal course of events (= if things had happened as expected) she would have gone with him.
He found that the report he had written had been overtaken by events (= it was no longer relevant).
A minority of patients suffered adverse events, including heart attacks.

senses.definition_vi: một điều xảy ra, đặc biệt là một điều gì đó quan trọng

senses.definition: a planned public or social occasion

examples.x: Is the city ready to host such a major sporting event?
The hospital is organizing a special fundraising event.
They were invited to attend the social event of the year.
As always, the annual event will be held in the grounds of the house.
Events are taking place throughout the summer to celebrate the city's centenary.

senses.definition_vi: một dịp công cộng hoặc xã hội đã được lên kế hoạch

senses.definition: one of the races or competitions in a sports programme

examples.x: The 800 metres is the fourth event of the afternoon.
Local winners compete in a national event in September.

senses.definition_vi: một trong các cuộc đua hoặc cuộc thi trong một chương trình thể thao

senses.definition: after something has happened

examples.x: I knew nothing about it until after the event.

senses.definition_vi: sau khi một điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: to understand something, or realize what you should have done, only after something has happened

examples.x: Anyone can be wise after the event.

senses.definition_vi: hiểu một điều gì đó, hoặc nhận ra những gì bạn nên làm, chỉ sau khi một điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: the birth of a baby
senses.definition_vi: sự ra đời của một em bé

senses.definition: used to emphasize or show that something is true or will happen despite other circumstances

examples.x: I think she'll agree to do it but in any event, all she can say is ‘no’.
I think the economy will recover in any event.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh hoặc cho thấy rằng một điều gì đó là đúng hoặc sẽ xảy ra bất chấp các hoàn cảnh khác

senses.definition: when the situation actually happened

examples.x: I got very nervous about the exam, but in the event, I needn't have worried; it was really easy.
In the event though, the dinner was a very entertaining affair.

senses.definition_vi: khi tình huống thực sự xảy ra

senses.definition: if something happens

examples.x: In the event of an accident, call this number.
Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
In the unlikely event of a crash, please remain calm.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: if that happens

examples.x: In that event, we will have to reconsider our offer.

senses.definition_vi: nếu điều đó xảy ra

senses.definition: at the end of a period of time or a series of events

examples.x: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
I'll get round to mending it eventually.
She hopes eventually to attend medical school and become a doctor.

senses.definition_vi: vào cuối một khoảng thời gian hoặc một chuỗi các sự kiện

senses.definition: used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if to mean ‘at any time’

examples.x: Nothing ever happens here.
Don't you ever get tired?
If you're ever in Miami, come and see us.
‘Have you ever been to Rome?’ ‘Yes, I have, actually. Not long ago.’
‘Have you ever thought of changing your job?’ ‘No, never/No I haven’t.’
She hardly ever (= almost never) goes out.
We've only ever talked on the phone.
I don't think I ever really thanked you properly.
He wondered whether it would ever actually happen.
We see them very seldom, if ever.
I'll never ever do that again!
I'm never speaking to you ever again!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các câu phủ định và câu hỏi, hoặc các câu có 'if' để có nghĩa là 'bất cứ lúc nào'

senses.definition: used for emphasis when you are comparing things

examples.x: It was raining harder than ever.
Consumers today have more choices than ever before.
It's my best-ever score.
It's the worst film I've ever seen.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh khi bạn đang so sánh mọi thứ

senses.definition: all the time or every time; always

examples.x: Paul, ever the optimist, agreed to try again.
She married the prince and they lived happily ever after.
He said he would love her for ever (and ever).
Their debts grew ever larger (= kept increasing).
the ever-growing problem
an ever-present danger

senses.definition_vi: suốt thời gian hoặc mỗi lần; luôn luôn

senses.definition: used after when, why, etc. to show that you are surprised or shocked

examples.x: Why ever did you agree?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau 'when', 'why', v.v. để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên hoặc sốc của bạn

senses.definition: used to emphasize that somebody does the same thing very often, usually in an annoying way

examples.x: All he ever does is grumble about things.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó làm cùng một việc rất thường xuyên, thường là một cách khó chịu

senses.definition: used to show that you are surprised or shocked

examples.x: Did you ever hear anything like it?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên hoặc sốc của bạn

senses.definition: continuously since the time mentioned

examples.x: He's had a car ever since he was 18.
I was bitten by a dog once and I've been afraid of them ever since.

senses.definition_vi: liên tục kể từ thời điểm được đề cập

senses.definition: very; really

examples.x: He looks ever so smart.
She's ever such a nice woman.
It's ever so easy.

senses.definition_vi: rất; thực sự

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is certainly true

examples.x: That was a disaster if ever there was one!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điều gì đó chắc chắn đúng

senses.definition: used to emphasize something you are talking about

examples.x: ‘You must have been upset by that.’ ‘Was I ever!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một điều gì đó bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: sometimes used at the end of an informal letter, before you write your name
senses.definition_vi: đôi khi được sử dụng ở cuối một lá thư không trang trọng, trước khi bạn viết tên mình

senses.definition: used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people

examples.x: She knows every student in the school.
I could hear every word they said.
We enjoyed every minute of our stay.
I go to the gym every day.
every week/month/year
I get that wrong every single time.
I read every last article in the newspaper (= all of them).
They were watching her every movement.
Every one of their songs has been a hit.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với danh từ số ít để chỉ tất cả các thành viên của một nhóm đồ vật hoặc người

senses.definition: used to say how often something happens or is done

examples.x: The buses go every 10 minutes.
We had to stop every few miles.
One in every three marriages ends in divorce.
He has every third day off (= he works for two days, then has one day off, then works for two days and so on).
We see each other every now and again.
Every now and then he regretted his decision.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói tần suất xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện của một điều gì đó

senses.definition: all possible

examples.x: We wish you every success.
He had every reason to be angry.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả có thể

senses.definition: every single one

examples.x: I look forward to seeing each and every one of you as we celebrate our 50th year.

senses.definition_vi: mỗi một cái duy nhất

senses.definition: each alternate one (= the first, third, fifth, etc. one, but not the second, fourth, sixth, etc.)

examples.x: They visit us every other week.

senses.definition_vi: mỗi cái xen kẽ (= cái thứ nhất, thứ ba, thứ năm, v.v., nhưng không phải cái thứ hai, thứ tư, thứ sáu, v.v.)

senses.definition: every person; all people

examples.x: Everybody knows Tom.
Have you asked everybody?
Didn't you like it? Everybody else did.

senses.definition_vi: mọi người; tất cả mọi người

senses.definition: used or happening every day or regularly; ordinary

examples.x: Change is a part of everyday life in business.
plates and dishes for everyday use
Using everyday objects, basic scientific principles can be explained to young children.
Violent crime is part of the everyday experience of the people in these neighbourhoods.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng hoặc xảy ra hàng ngày hoặc thường xuyên; bình thường

senses.definition: every person; all people

examples.x: Everyone cheered and clapped.
Everyone has a chance to win.
Everyone brought their partner to the party.
Everyone brought his or her partner to the party.
The police questioned everyone in the room.
The teacher commented on everyone's work.
Everyone else was there.

senses.definition_vi: mọi người; tất cả mọi người

senses.definition: all things

examples.x: Everything had gone.
When we confronted him, he denied everything.
Take this bag, and leave everything else to me.
She seemed to have everything—looks, money, intelligence.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả mọi thứ

senses.definition: the situation now; life generally

examples.x: Everything in the capital is now quiet.
‘How's everything with you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’

senses.definition_vi: tình hình hiện tại; cuộc sống nói chung

senses.definition: the most important thing

examples.x: Money isn't everything.
My family means everything to me.

senses.definition_vi: điều quan trọng nhất

senses.definition: and so on; and other similar things

examples.x: Have you got his name and address and everything?
She told me about the baby and everything.

senses.definition_vi: và cứ tiếp tục như vậy; và những thứ tương tự

senses.definition: in, to or at every place; all places

examples.x: I've looked everywhere.
He follows me everywhere.
We'll have to eat here—everywhere else is full.
Everywhere we went was full of tourists.

senses.definition_vi: ở, đến hoặc tại mọi nơi; tất cả các nơi

senses.definition: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that something is true

examples.x: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
There is a growing body of evidence for the existence of black holes that are ten times as massive as the Sun.
There is not a shred of evidence that the meeting actually took place.

examples.cf: evidence to suggest, support, show, etc.
examples.x: Have you any evidence to support this allegation?
The study provides empirical evidence (= based on experiments or experience) to prove that the drug has no long-term side effects.
Anecdotal evidence (= based on personal accounts) suggests that drivers over the age of 70 find it difficult to get insurance.
On the evidence of their recent matches, it is unlikely the Spanish team will win.
In the absence of evidence to the contrary, it should be assumed that proper procedures were followed.

senses.definition_vi: những sự thật, dấu hiệu hoặc đồ vật khiến bạn tin rằng một điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: the information that is used in court to try to prove something

examples.x: I was asked to give evidence (= to say what I knew, describe what I had seen, etc.) at the trial.
The defence accused the prosecution of withholding several key pieces of evidence.
circumstantial/forensic evidence
Despite a lack of evidence against him, Burton will appear in court next week.
He was released when the judge ruled there was no evidence against him.
The emails were presented as evidence of his involvement in the fraud.
The police officer took a statement which was later used in evidence.

senses.definition_vi: thông tin được sử dụng trong tòa án để cố gắng chứng minh một điều gì đó

senses.definition: (considering) the evidence on both sides of an argument, to find the most likely reason for or result of something

examples.x: The balance of evidence suggests the Liberal party's decline began before the First World War.
The coroner thought that on the balance of probabilities, the pilot had suffered a stroke just before the crash.

senses.definition_vi: (xem xét) bằng chứng từ cả hai phía của một lập luận, để tìm ra lý do hoặc kết quả có khả năng xảy ra nhất của một điều gì đó

senses.definition: (to be) present and clearly seen

examples.x: The police were much in evidence at today's demonstration.
a trend that has been much in evidence in recent years

senses.definition_vi: (để là) hiện diện và nhìn thấy rõ ràng

senses.definition: clear; easily seen

examples.x: The orchestra played with evident enjoyment.
It has now become evident to us that a mistake has been made.
The growing interest in history is clearly evident in the number of people visiting museums and country houses.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng; dễ nhìn thấy

senses.definition: enjoying harming others; morally bad and cruel

examples.x: Police described the killer as ‘a desperate and evil man’.
an evil genius/dictator
President Reagan referred to the Soviet Union as the ‘evil empire’.
an evil grin
Her face was full of evil intent.

senses.definition_vi: thích làm hại người khác; xấu xa và tàn nhẫn về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: having a harmful effect on people; morally bad

examples.x: evil deeds
In his speech he described the evil effects of racism.

senses.definition_vi: có tác động xấu đến con người; xấu xa về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: connected with the devil and with what is bad in the world

examples.x: It was an ancient charm to ward off evil spirits.
She had been deceived by an evil demon.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến quỷ và những điều xấu xa trên thế giới

senses.definition: extremely unpleasant

examples.x: The rubbish bin was giving off an evil smell.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ khó chịu

senses.definition: the time when you have to do something difficult or unpleasant

examples.x: I’d better go and see the dentist—I can’t put off the evil hour any longer.
If you keep on borrowing, you are only postponing the evil day when you have to pay it all back.

senses.definition_vi: thời điểm bạn phải làm điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: a person or spirit who is thought to have a good/bad influence over you
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc linh hồn được cho là có ảnh hưởng tốt/xấu đến bạn

senses.definition: an unpleasant drink that is a mixture of different things
senses.definition_vi: một thức uống khó chịu là hỗn hợp của nhiều thứ khác nhau

senses.definition: a force that causes bad things to happen; morally bad behaviour

examples.x: the eternal struggle between good and evil
He believed he could rid the world of the forces of evil.
to fight/combat evil
the battle/fight/struggle/war against evil
He was a good man who was forced to do evil.
You cannot pretend there's no evil in the world.

senses.definition_vi: một thế lực gây ra những điều xấu; hành vi xấu xa về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: a bad or harmful thing; the bad effect of something

examples.x: the evils of drugs/alcohol
They hardly mentioned such social evils as racism and sexism.

senses.definition_vi: một điều xấu hoặc có hại; tác động xấu của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the less unpleasant of two unpleasant choices
senses.definition_vi: lựa chọn ít khó chịu hơn trong hai lựa chọn khó chịu

senses.definition: a thing that is bad or that you do not like but that you must accept for a particular reason

examples.x: The loss of jobs is regarded as a necessary evil in the fight against inflation.

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó xấu hoặc bạn không thích nhưng bạn phải chấp nhận vì một lý do cụ thể

senses.definition: to bring a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind

examples.x: The music evoked memories of her youth.
His case is unlikely to evoke public sympathy.

senses.definition_vi: mang lại một cảm giác, một ký ức hoặc một hình ảnh trong tâm trí bạn

senses.definition: the slow steady development of plants, animals, etc. during the history of the earth, as they adapt to changes in their environment

examples.x: the evolution of the human species
Darwin’s theory of evolution
Finally it was legal to teach evolution everywhere in America.

senses.definition_vi: sự phát triển chậm và ổn định của thực vật, động vật, v.v. trong lịch sử trái đất, khi chúng thích nghi với những thay đổi trong môi trường của chúng

senses.definition: the slow steady development of something

examples.x: In politics Britain has preferred evolution to revolution (= slow steady development to sudden violent change)
cultural trends and evolutions

senses.definition_vi: sự phát triển chậm và ổn định của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: connected with evolution; connected with slow steady development and change

examples.x: evolutionary theory
evolutionary change

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến tiến hóa; liên quan đến sự phát triển và thay đổi chậm và ổn định

senses.definition: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complicated form; to develop something in this way

examples.x: The idea evolved from a drawing I discovered in the attic.
The company has evolved into a major chemical manufacturer.
Each school must evolve its own way of working.

senses.definition_vi: phát triển dần dần, đặc biệt là từ dạng đơn giản đến dạng phức tạp hơn; phát triển một cái gì đó theo cách này

senses.definition: to develop over time, often many generations, into forms that are better adapted to survive changes in their environment

examples.x: The three species evolved from a single ancestor.
The dolphin has evolved a highly developed jaw.

senses.definition_vi: phát triển theo thời gian, thường là qua nhiều thế hệ, thành các dạng thích nghi tốt hơn để tồn tại trước những thay đổi trong môi trường của chúng

senses.definition: correct in every detail

examples.x: The new palace is an exact replica of the original building.
It is an exact copy of the original document.
The model is exact in every detail.
For now they are keeping the exact date and location of the wedding a secret.
The exact nature of her illness (= precisely what her illness is) has not been made public.
Her second husband was the exact opposite of her first (= completely different).
The colours were an almost exact match.
She's in her mid-thirties—thirty-six to be exact.
I had the exact same problem as you when I first started.
What were his exact words?
A clear definition requires very exact wording.
Nobody knows the exact number of people affected, but it is over 10 000.
He started to phone me at the exact moment I started to phone him (= at the same time).

senses.definition_vi: chính xác từng chi tiết

senses.definition: very accurate and careful about details

examples.x: He was very exact about everything he did.

senses.definition_vi: rất chính xác và cẩn thận về chi tiết

senses.definition: using accurate measurements and following set rules

examples.x: Assessing insurance risk can never be an exact science.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng phép đo chính xác và tuân theo các quy tắc đã đặt ra

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is correct in every way or in every detail

examples.x: It's exactly nine o'clock.
It happened almost exactly a year ago.
Your answer is exactly right.
It was a warm day, if not exactly hot.
I know exactly how she felt.
It's impossible to say exactly what happened.
Do exactly as I tell you.
You haven't changed at all—you still look exactly the same.
His words had exactly the opposite effect.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điều gì đó là đúng theo mọi cách hoặc mọi chi tiết

senses.definition: used to ask for more information about something

examples.x: Where exactly did you stay in France?
Exactly what are you trying to tell me?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu thêm thông tin về một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used as a reply, agreeing with what somebody has just said, or emphasizing that it is correct

examples.x: ‘You mean somebody in this room must be the murderer?’ ‘Exactly.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng làm câu trả lời, đồng ý với những gì ai đó vừa nói, hoặc nhấn mạnh rằng điều đó là đúng

senses.definition: used when you are saying the opposite of what you really mean

examples.x: He wasn't exactly pleased to see us—in fact he refused to open the door.
It's not exactly beautiful, is it? (= it's ugly)

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn nói điều ngược lại với những gì bạn thực sự có ý

senses.definition: used when you are correcting something that somebody has said

examples.x: ‘So he told you you'd got the job?’ ‘Not exactly, but he said they were impressed with me.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang sửa chữa một điều gì đó mà ai đó đã nói

senses.definition: to make something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is

examples.x: The hotel was really filthy and I'm not exaggerating.
He tends to exaggerate the difficulties.
I'm sure he exaggerates his Irish accent (= tries to sound more Irish than he really is).
Demand for the product has been greatly exaggerated.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một cái gì đó có vẻ lớn hơn, tốt hơn, tệ hơn hoặc quan trọng hơn so với thực tế

senses.definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do

examples.x: to take an exam
to pass/fail an exam
I hate doing exams.
to sit an exam
to mark an exam
to grade an exam
I failed the college entrance exam (= to get a place at college).
Every term we would have exams in maths, English, French, etc.
She did well in her exams.
She did well on her exams.
an exam paper
I got my exam results today.
A lot of students suffer from exam nerves.

senses.definition_vi: một bài kiểm tra viết, nói hoặc thực hành chính thức, đặc biệt là ở trường học hoặc đại học, để xem bạn biết bao nhiêu về một môn học, hoặc bạn có thể làm gì

senses.definition: a medical test of a particular part of the body

examples.x: an eye exam

senses.definition_vi: một xét nghiệm y tế về một bộ phận cụ thể của cơ thể

senses.definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do

examples.x: successful candidates in GCSE examinations
to sit an examination in mathematics
In 1864 he passed the examination for the Indian Civil Service.
Applicants are selected for jobs on the results of a competitive examination.

senses.definition_vi: một bài kiểm tra viết, nói hoặc thực hành chính thức, đặc biệt là ở trường học hoặc đại học, để xem bạn biết bao nhiêu về một môn học, hoặc bạn có thể làm gì

senses.definition: the act of looking at or considering something very carefully

examples.x: Careful examination of the ruins revealed an even earlier temple.
The issue needs further examination.
The review is the most detailed examination of policing since 1992.
The chapter concludes with a brief examination of some of the factors causing family break-up.
After a thorough examination, they announced that the suspicious device was harmless.
On closer examination it was found that the signature was not genuine.
Your proposals are still under examination.
The party would open up the issue to examination by a Senate Committee.

senses.definition_vi: hành động nhìn hoặc xem xét một cái gì đó rất cẩn thận

senses.definition: a close look at something/somebody, especially to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem

examples.x: a medical/physical examination
a post-mortem/forensic examination
Regular breast examination is advised.
A specialist should carry out an examination of the patient.
Diagnosis can be made only by direct examination of affected brain tissue.
Further examination by an orthopaedic surgeon will be needed today.

senses.definition_vi: một cái nhìn cận cảnh về một cái gì đó/ai đó, đặc biệt là để xem có bất cứ điều gì sai trái hoặc để tìm ra nguyên nhân của một vấn đề

senses.definition: to consider or study an idea, a subject, etc. very carefully

examples.x: This study sets out to examine in detail the possible effects of climate change.
Her new show critically examines the relationship between the arts and popular culture.
This important issue must be carefully examined.
Only recently have historians begun to examine the impact and influence of these changes.
It is necessary to examine how the proposals can be carried out.
The weather gave researchers an opportunity to examine what happens to insect numbers when temperatures rise.

senses.definition_vi: xem xét hoặc nghiên cứu một ý tưởng, một chủ đề, v.v. rất cẩn thận

senses.definition: to look at somebody/something closely, to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem

examples.x: The doctor examined her carefully but could find nothing wrong.
to be examined by a doctor/psychiatrist/specialist/vet
She examined herself closely in the mirror.
The samples were examined under the microscope for the presence of damaged cells.
The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
Investigators examined the room minutely for clues.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để xem có bất cứ điều gì sai trái hoặc để tìm ra nguyên nhân của một vấn đề

senses.definition: to give somebody a test to see how much they know about a subject or what they can do

examples.x: The students will be examined in all subjects at the end of term.
You are only being examined on this semester's work.
The course is externally examined (= arranged and marked by somebody from outside a school, a university or an organization).

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó làm bài kiểm tra để xem họ biết bao nhiêu về một môn học hoặc họ có thể làm gì

senses.definition: to ask somebody questions formally, especially in court

examples.x: The prosecution examined 20 witnesses.

senses.definition_vi: hỏi ai đó một cách chính thức, đặc biệt là tại tòa

senses.definition: to be crazy
senses.definition_vi: bị điên

senses.definition: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say

examples.x: Let me give you an example.
It is important to cite examples to support your argument.
to provide/offer an example
I shall take four different examples from contemporary literature to illustrate my point.
Can you show me an example of what you mean?
This dictionary has many examples of how words are used.
Just to give you an example of his generosity—he gave me his old car and wouldn't take any money for it.
The progress the students have made serves as an example of the benefit of small class sizes.
By way of example, we'll look at our most recent advertising campaign.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó như một đối tượng, một sự kiện hoặc một tình huống cho thấy, giải thích hoặc hỗ trợ những gì bạn nói

senses.definition: a thing that is typical of or represents a particular group or set

examples.x: This is a good example of the artist's early work.
It is a perfect example of this type of architecture.
Japan is often quoted as the prime example of a modern industrial nation.
It is a classic example of how not to design a new city centre.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó điển hình hoặc đại diện cho một nhóm hoặc tập hợp cụ thể

senses.definition: a person or their behaviour that is thought to be a good model for others to copy

examples.x: Her courage is an example to us all.
He sets an example for the other students.
They are a shining example of the best of the human spirit.
He is a captain who leads by example.
Top management should be seen to lead by example.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc hành vi của họ được coi là một mô hình tốt để người khác noi theo

senses.definition: a person’s behaviour, either good or bad, that other people copy

examples.x: It would be a mistake to follow his example.
They started to plan protests, inspired by the example of their neighbours.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi của một người, dù tốt hay xấu, mà người khác sao chép

senses.definition: used to emphasize something that explains or supports what you are saying; used to give an example of what you are saying

examples.x: There is a similar word in many languages, for example in French and Italian.

It is possible to combine computer science with other subjects, for example physics.
An athlete, for example, might turn the pedals 80 times a minute.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó giải thích hoặc ủng hộ điều bạn đang nói; được dùng để đưa ra một ví dụ về điều bạn đang nói

senses.definition: to punish somebody as a warning to others not to do the same thing

examples.x: The teacher made an example of him by suspending him from school.

senses.definition_vi: trừng phạt ai đó như một lời cảnh báo cho người khác không được làm điều tương tự

senses.definition: to be greater than a particular number or amount

examples.x: The price will not exceed £100.

senses.definition_vi: lớn hơn một số hoặc một lượng nhất định

senses.definition: to do more than the law or an order, etc. allows you to do

examples.x: She was exceeding the speed limit (= driving faster than is allowed).
The officers had exceeded their authority.

senses.definition_vi: làm nhiều hơn những gì luật pháp hoặc mệnh lệnh, v.v. cho phép bạn làm

senses.definition: to be better than expected

examples.x: His achievements have exceeded expectations.
The amount raised has far exceeded our wildest expectations.

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn mong đợi

senses.definition: the quality of being extremely good

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất của việc cực kỳ tốt

examples.x: an excellent book/article
excellent results/work
The meal looked and tasted excellent.
Both the food and the service were truly excellent.
The performances of the cast are uniformly excellent throughout.
She has done an excellent job of adapting the novel for the screen.

The party provided an excellent opportunity to meet new people.
The apartment is in excellent condition and is ready to move into.
He was great at sport and excellent at art.
Our staff are excellent at advising small businesses.
The experience was excellent for students' self-confidence.
Ferns are excellent for planting in shady parts of the garden.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ tốt

senses.definition: used to show that you are very pleased about something or that you approve of something

examples.x: You can all come? Excellent!

examples.cf: it is excellent to do something
examples.x: It's excellent to see so many people at today's event!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để thể hiện rằng bạn rất hài lòng về điều gì đó hoặc bạn tán thành điều gì đó

senses.definition: used before you mention something that makes a statement not completely true

examples.x: I didn't tell him anything except that I needed the money.
Our dresses were the same except mine was red.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trước khi bạn đề cập đến điều gì đó làm cho một tuyên bố không hoàn toàn đúng

examples.x: We work every day except Sunday.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trước khi bạn đề cập đến điều hoặc người duy nhất mà một tuyên bố không đúng

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật không được bao gồm trong một tuyên bố chung

senses.definition: a thing that does not follow a rule

examples.x: Good writing is unfortunately the exception rather than the rule (= it is unusual).

senses.definition_vi: một điều không tuân theo quy tắc

senses.definition: people say that something is the exception that proves the rule when they are stating something that seems to be different from the normal situation, but they mean that the normal situation remains true in general

examples.x: Most electronics companies have not done well this year, but ours is the exception that proves the rule.

senses.short_meaning_vi: ngoại lệ chứng minh quy tắc
senses.definition_vi: người ta nói rằng một điều gì đó là ngoại lệ chứng minh quy tắc khi họ đưa ra một điều gì đó có vẻ khác với tình huống bình thường, nhưng họ có ý rằng tình huống bình thường vẫn đúng nói chung

senses.definition: to allow somebody not to follow the usual rule on one occasion or for one particular reason

examples.x: Children are not usually allowed in, but I'm prepared to make an exception in this case.

We are making a special exception for Emma because of her condition.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó không phải tuân theo quy tắc thông thường vào một dịp hoặc vì một lý do cụ thể

senses.definition: to object strongly to something; to be angry about something

examples.x: I take great exception to the fact that you told my wife before you told me.

senses.definition_vi: phản đối mạnh mẽ điều gì đó; tức giận về điều gì đó

senses.definition: except; not including

examples.x: All his novels are set in Italy with the exception of his last.

senses.definition_vi: ngoại trừ; không bao gồm

senses.definition: used to emphasize that the statement you are making is always true and everyone or everything is included

examples.x: All students without exception must take the English examination.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng tuyên bố bạn đang đưa ra luôn đúng và mọi người hoặc mọi thứ đều được bao gồm

senses.definition: unusually good

examples.x: At the age of five he showed exceptional talent as a musician.

senses.definition_vi: tốt một cách khác thường

senses.definition: very unusual

examples.x: This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.

senses.definition_vi: rất khác thường

senses.definition_vi: thêm vào một lượng cần thiết, thông thường hoặc hợp pháp

senses.definition: required as extra payment

examples.x: The full excess fare had to be paid.

senses.definition_vi: cần thiết như một khoản thanh toán bổ sung

examples.x: You can throw away any excess.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn mức cần thiết, hợp lý hoặc chấp nhận được

senses.definition: an amount by which something is larger than something else

examples.x: We cover costs up to £600 and then you pay the excess.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng mà một cái gì đó lớn hơn một cái gì đó khác

examples.x: There is an excess of £100 on each claim under this policy.

senses.definition_vi: phần của yêu cầu bảo hiểm mà một người phải trả trong khi công ty bảo hiểm trả phần còn lại

senses.definition: the fact of doing too much of something, especially eating or drinking

examples.x: He gave in to bouts of alcoholic excess.

senses.definition_vi: việc làm quá nhiều điều gì đó, đặc biệt là ăn uống

senses.definition: extreme behaviour that is unacceptable, illegal or morally wrong

examples.x: We need a free press to curb government excesses.
legislation to control the worst excesses of the press

senses.definition_vi: hành vi cực đoan không thể chấp nhận được, bất hợp pháp hoặc sai trái về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate

examples.x: They complained about the excessive noise coming from the upstairs flat.
The amounts she borrowed were not excessive.
Excessive eating increases the risk of heart failure.
He claimed that the police had used excessive force.

senses.definition_vi: lớn hơn những gì có vẻ hợp lý hoặc phù hợp

We need to promote an open exchange of ideas and information.
an exchange of glances/insults
an exchange of fire (= between enemy soldiers)

Wool and timber were sent to Egypt in exchange for linen or papyrus.
I'll type your report if you'll babysit in exchange.

senses.definition_vi: hành động đưa cho ai đó một thứ gì đó hoặc làm điều gì đó cho ai đó và nhận lại thứ gì đó

senses.definition: the process of changing an amount of one currency for an equal value of another

examples.x: currency exchange facilities
Where can I find the best exchange rate/rate of exchange?

senses.definition_vi: quá trình thay đổi một lượng tiền tệ này cho một giá trị tương đương của tiền tệ khác

examples.x: Our school does an exchange with a school in France.

Nick went on the French exchange.

senses.definition_vi: một thỏa thuận khi hai người hoặc nhóm từ các quốc gia khác nhau đến thăm nhà nhau hoặc làm công việc của nhau trong một thời gian ngắn

senses.definition: a conversation or an argument

examples.x: There was only time for a brief exchange.

senses.definition_vi: một cuộc trò chuyện hoặc một cuộc tranh luận

senses.definition: a building where business people met in the past to buy and sell a particular type of goods

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà nơi các doanh nhân gặp nhau trong quá khứ để mua và bán một loại hàng hóa cụ thể

senses.definition: a place where phone calls are connected so that people can speak to each other
senses.definition_vi: một nơi mà các cuộc gọi điện thoại được kết nối để mọi người có thể nói chuyện với nhau

The two men exchanged blows (= hit each other).

senses.definition_vi: đưa cho ai đó một thứ gì đó và đồng thời nhận lại thứ tương tự từ họ

senses.definition: to change an amount of one currency for an equal value of another

examples.x: Where can I exchange my money?
You can exchange your currency for dollars in the hotel.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi một lượng tiền tệ này cho một giá trị tương đương của tiền tệ khác

senses.definition: to give or return something that you have and get something different or better instead

examples.x: If it doesn't fit, take it back and the store will exchange it.

senses.definition_vi: cho hoặc trả lại thứ bạn có và nhận lại thứ khác hoặc tốt hơn thay thế

examples.x: The firm has just exchanged contracts on a nine-acre site.

senses.definition_vi: khi người mua và người bán trao đổi hợp đồng, đặc biệt là trong việc bán nhà hoặc đất, họ mỗi người ký một bản sao của hợp đồng và đưa cho người kia

senses.definition: to have an argument with somebody

senses.definition_vi: tranh cãi với ai đó

The new restaurant is nothing to get excited about (= not particularly good).
An excited crowd of people gathered around her.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện sự vui vẻ và nhiệt tình

senses.definition: nervous or upset and unable to relax

examples.x: Some horses become excited when they're in traffic.

senses.definition_vi: lo lắng hoặc khó chịu và không thể thư giãn

senses.definition: feeling sexual desire
senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy ham muốn tình dục

senses.definition: the state of feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm

examples.x: The news caused great excitement among her friends.
The sport needs new stars to generate excitement.

He did not share their excitement about the project.
I could hardly contain my excitement about going with Brandon.
She told of her excitement at the prospect of a new career as a pilot.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện niềm hạnh phúc và sự nhiệt tình

senses.definition_vi: thứ mà bạn thấy thú vị

senses.definition: the state of feeling sexual desire
senses.definition_vi: trạng thái cảm thấy ham muốn tình dục

examples.x: This is an exciting opportunity for me.

an exciting prospect/possibility

They waited and waited for something exciting to happen.
I still find the job exciting.
That's what makes the game so exciting for the fans.

examples.cf: it is exciting (for somebody) to do something
examples.x: It was really exciting for them to see him in person.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra sự quan tâm hoặc hứng thú lớn

senses.definition: to deliberately not include something in what you are doing or considering

examples.x: The cost of borrowing has been excluded from the inflation figures.

senses.definition: a person who chooses, or is forced, to live away from his or her own country

examples.x: political exiles

senses.definition_vi: một người chọn, hoặc bị buộc, sống xa đất nước của mình

senses.definition: to be real; to be present in a place or situation

examples.x: Does life exist on other planets?
Few of these monkeys still exist in the wild.
Major differences continue to exist between the two countries.
A solution has been found and the problem no longer exists.
On his retirement the post will cease to exist.
Adequate facilities already exist to serve the needs of people visiting the town.
It is an art gallery that exists only on the internet.
Evidence of their relationship exists in the form of a series of letters.
I didn't think people like that existed any more.
The charity exists to support victims of crime.

senses.definition_vi: là có thật; có mặt ở một địa điểm hoặc tình huống

senses.definition: to live, especially in a difficult situation or with very little money

examples.x: We existed on a diet of rice.
We can't exist on the money I'm earning.

senses.definition_vi: sống, đặc biệt là trong một tình huống khó khăn hoặc với rất ít tiền

senses.definition: the state or fact of being real or living or of being present

examples.x: I was unaware of his existence until today.
to believe in the existence of God
the mystery of human existence
The continued existence of the industry depends on the investment of public money.
The islanders depend on a good harvest for their very existence (= in order to continue to live).
The mere existence of these strange creatures fascinated him.
Some groups in the industry seek to deny the existence of a global warming problem.
The school owed its existence to the generosity of one man.
The company has been in existence since 1924.
This is the oldest Hebrew manuscript in existence.
Pakistan came into existence as an independent country in 1947.
The book acknowledges the existence of graffiti as an art form.
Several species are in danger of being hunted out of existence.
There was a fear that the club might go out of existence for lack of support.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái hoặc sự thật của việc có thật hoặc sống hoặc có mặt

senses.definition: a way of living, especially when this is difficult or boring

examples.x: The family endured a miserable existence in a cramped apartment.
They eke out a precarious existence (= they have hardly enough money to live on).
He lives a hand-to-mouth existence (= he has only enough money for basic needs such as food).

senses.definition_vi: một cách sống, đặc biệt là khi điều này khó khăn hoặc nhàm chán

senses.definition: a way out of a public building or vehicle

examples.x: Where's the exit?
There is a fire exit on each floor of the building.
The emergency exit is at the back of the bus.

senses.definition_vi: một lối ra khỏi một tòa nhà công cộng hoặc phương tiện giao thông

senses.definition: a place where vehicles can leave a road to join another road

examples.x: Leave the roundabout at the second exit.
Take the exit for Brno.

senses.definition_vi: một nơi mà các phương tiện có thể rời khỏi một con đường để nhập vào một con đường khác

senses.definition: an act of leaving, especially of an actor from the stage

examples.x: The heroine made her exit to great applause.
He made a quick exit to avoid meeting them.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động rời đi, đặc biệt là của một diễn viên khỏi sân khấu

senses.definition: the fact of leaving a particular situation or activity

examples.x: They were disappointed by the team's early exit from the World Cup.

senses.definition_vi: sự thật của việc rời khỏi một tình huống hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: to go out; to leave a building, stage, vehicle, etc.

examples.x: We exited through a corridor into a back alley.
We exited via a fire door.
As the actors exited the stage the lights went on.

senses.definition_vi: đi ra ngoài; rời khỏi một tòa nhà, sân khấu, phương tiện giao thông, v.v.

senses.definition: to finish using a computer program

examples.x: To exit from this page, press the return key.
I exited the database and switched off the computer.

senses.definition_vi: kết thúc việc sử dụng một chương trình máy tính

senses.definition: used in the instructions printed in a play to say that an actor must leave the stage

examples.x: Exit Macbeth.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các hướng dẫn in trong một vở kịch để nói rằng một diễn viên phải rời khỏi sân khấu

senses.definition: from or in another country, especially a tropical one; seeming exciting and unusual because it seems to be connected with other countries

examples.x: brightly-coloured exotic flowers/plants/birds
She travels to all kinds of exotic locations all over the world.
The fruits sound exotic. Do they taste good?

senses.definition_vi: từ hoặc ở một quốc gia khác, đặc biệt là một quốc gia nhiệt đới; có vẻ thú vị và khác thường vì nó có vẻ liên quan đến các quốc gia khác

senses.definition: to become greater in size, number or importance; to make something greater in size, number or importance

examples.x: Metals expand when they are heated.
Student numbers are expanding rapidly.
a greatly expanded version of his earlier book
A child's vocabulary expands through reading.
The waist expands to fit all sizes.
The gallery's focus will expand to include the work of modern artists.
Last year, the event expanded from two to three days.
They are continuing to expand the range of goods and services they offer.
to expand a programme/service
In breathing the chest muscles expand the rib cage and allow air to be sucked into the lungs.
There are no plans to expand the local airport.
The short film is being expanded into a full-length documentary.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên lớn hơn về kích thước, số lượng hoặc tầm quan trọng; làm cho một cái gì đó lớn hơn về kích thước, số lượng hoặc tầm quan trọng

senses.definition: if a business expands or is expanded, new branches are opened, it makes more money, etc.

examples.x: an expanding economy (= with more businesses starting and growing)
The organic market is rapidly expanding among middle-income shoppers.
They have recently expanded into the Middle East.
We've expanded the business by opening two more stores.
The company is planning to expand its American operations.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một doanh nghiệp mở rộng hoặc được mở rộng, các chi nhánh mới sẽ được mở, nó kiếm được nhiều tiền hơn, v.v.

senses.definition: to talk more; to add details to what you are saying

examples.x: I repeated the question and waited for her to expand.

senses.definition_vi: nói thêm; thêm chi tiết vào những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: an act of increasing or making something increase in size, amount or importance

examples.x: a period of rapid economic expansion
Despite the recession the company is confident of further expansion.
The expansion of higher education will continue.
The book is an expansion of a series of lectures given last year.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tăng hoặc làm cho một cái gì đó tăng về kích thước, số lượng hoặc tầm quan trọng

senses.definition: to think or believe that something will happen or that somebody will do something

examples.x: The company is expecting record sales this year.
Change often happens when you least expect it.
Don't expect sympathy from me!
That's not the sort of behaviour I expect of you!
They never expected to find their dream home.
I looked back, half expecting to see someone following me.
Analysts expect the company to announce growth of at least 5 per cent.
I fully expected her to refuse my offer.
House prices are expected to rise sharply.
Do you really expect me to believe you?
Many people were expecting (that) the peace talks would break down.
It is widely expected that interest rates will rise.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ hoặc tin rằng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra hoặc ai đó sẽ làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be waiting for somebody/something to arrive, as this has been arranged

examples.x: to expect a visit/call/letter from somebody
We were expecting him yesterday.
They are not expected until tomorrow.
Are you expecting visitors?
I'm expecting an important call.
We were expecting him to arrive yesterday.

senses.definition_vi: đang chờ đợi ai đó/điều gì đó đến, vì điều này đã được sắp xếp

senses.definition: to demand that somebody will do something because it is their duty or responsibility

examples.x: It is reasonable to expect changes in the way we work.
No one has a right to expect good results without working hard.
These are the high standards that hotel guests have come to expect.
He's still getting over his illness, so it's unrealistic to expect too much from him.
Are you clear what is expected of you?
You can't reasonably expect people to pay such high taxes.
We are expected to work on Saturdays.
It would be unreasonable to expect them to do all that work for free.
I expect to be paid promptly for the work.

senses.definition_vi: đòi hỏi ai đó sẽ làm điều gì đó vì đó là nhiệm vụ hoặc trách nhiệm của họ

senses.definition: used when you think something is probably true

examples.x: ‘Will you be late?’ ‘I expect so.’
‘Are you going out tonight?’ ‘I don't expect so.’
‘Who’s eaten all the cake?’ ‘Tom, I expect/I expect it was Tom.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó có lẽ đúng

senses.definition: to be pregnant

examples.x: Ann's expecting a baby in June.
I didn't know she was expecting!

senses.definition_vi: mang thai

senses.definition: to be likely to happen; to be quite normal

examples.x: A little tiredness after taking the medication is to be expected.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng xảy ra; khá bình thường

senses.definition: used to tell somebody not to be surprised by something

examples.x: She swore at you? What do you expect when you treat her like that?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó đừng ngạc nhiên về điều gì đó

senses.definition: a belief that something will happen because it is likely

examples.x: We are confident in our expectation of a full recovery.
We certainly had a reasonable expectation of success.
the government's expectations about the economy
There was a general expectation that he would win.
She had a legitimate expectation that her application would succeed.
The expectation is that property prices will rise.
Buyers are holding back in expectation of further price cuts.
I applied for the post more in hope than expectation.
Contrary to expectations, interest rates did not rise.
Against all expectations, she was enjoying herself.

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin rằng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra vì nó có khả năng

senses.definition: a hope that something good will happen

examples.x: She went to college with great expectations.
to have high/low expectations
I don't want to raise your expectations too much.
The results exceeded our expectations.
The numbers attending fell short of expectations.
The event did not live up to expectations.
There was an air of expectation and great curiosity.
He has high expectations for the team.
The White House said that they did not have any grand expectations for today's meeting.

senses.definition_vi: hy vọng rằng điều gì đó tốt đẹp sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: a strong belief about the way something should happen or how somebody should behave

examples.x: Unfortunately the new software has failed to meet expectations.
Some parents have unrealistic expectations of their children.

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin mạnh mẽ về cách mọi thứ nên xảy ra hoặc cách ai đó nên cư xử

senses.definition: that you think will happen

examples.x: Double the expected number of people came to the meeting.
this year’s expected earnings

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn nghĩ rằng sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: an organized journey with a particular purpose, especially to find out about a place that is not well known

examples.x: to plan/lead/go on an expedition
Captain Scott's expedition to the South Pole
Hawkins had died on the same expedition a few weeks earlier.

senses.definition_vi: một chuyến đi có tổ chức với một mục đích cụ thể, đặc biệt là để tìm hiểu về một địa điểm chưa được biết đến nhiều

senses.definition: the people who go on an expedition

examples.x: Five members of Scott's expedition made it to the South Pole.

senses.definition_vi: những người tham gia một cuộc thám hiểm

senses.definition: a short trip that you make when you want or need something

examples.x: Win a fantastic shopping expedition to New York!

senses.definition_vi: một chuyến đi ngắn mà bạn thực hiện khi bạn muốn hoặc cần một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the act of spending or using money; an amount of money spent

examples.x: a reduction in public/government/military expenditure
plans to increase expenditure on health
The budget provided for a total expenditure of £27 billion.
Savings have been disposed of in order to meet the growing gap between income and expenditure.

senses.definition_vi: hành động chi tiêu hoặc sử dụng tiền; một số tiền đã chi tiêu

senses.definition: the use of energy, time, materials, etc.

examples.x: the expenditure of emotion
This study represents a major expenditure of time and effort.

senses.definition_vi: việc sử dụng năng lượng, thời gian, vật liệu, v.v.

senses.definition: the money that you spend on something

examples.x: The garden was transformed at great expense.
No expense was spared (= they spent as much money as was needed) to make the party a success.
He's arranged everything, no expense spared.
She always travels first-class regardless of expense.
The results are well worth the expense.

senses.definition_vi: số tiền bạn chi tiêu cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: something that makes you spend money

examples.x: Running a car is a big expense.
The company views its workers as an expense instead of an asset.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó làm cho bạn chi tiêu tiền

senses.definition: money spent in doing a particular job, or for a particular purpose

examples.x: living/medical/travel expenses
legal/household expenses
The company has cut operating expenses to their lowest levels in three years
Can I give you something towards expenses?
financial help to meet the expenses of an emergency
The payments he gets barely cover his expenses.
Property investors are entitled to offset the expenses incurred buying the property.

senses.definition_vi: tiền chi tiêu trong khi làm một công việc cụ thể, hoặc cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: money that you spend while you are working and that your employer will pay back to you later

examples.x: You can claim back your travelling/travel expenses.
We paid their expenses, but nothing more.
an all-expenses-paid trip
to take a client out for a meal on expenses

senses.definition_vi: tiền mà bạn chi tiêu khi bạn đang làm việc và mà người sử dụng lao động của bạn sẽ hoàn trả cho bạn sau này

senses.definition: paid for by somebody

examples.x: We were taken out for a meal at the company's expense.

senses.definition_vi: được ai đó chi trả

senses.definition: if you make a joke at somebody’s expense, you laugh at them and make them feel silly
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói đùa với chi phí của ai đó, bạn cười nhạo họ và làm cho họ cảm thấy ngớ ngẩn

senses.definition: with loss or damage to somebody/something

examples.x: He built up the business at the expense of his health.
an education system that benefits the brightest children at the expense of everyone else

senses.definition_vi: với sự mất mát hoặc thiệt hại cho ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to spend money on something

examples.x: They went to all the expense of redecorating the house and then they moved.

senses.definition_vi: chi tiêu tiền cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to make somebody spend money on something

examples.x: Their visit put us to a lot of expense.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó chi tiêu tiền cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: costing a lot of money

examples.x: an expensive car/restaurant/holiday
I can't afford it—it's too expensive.
Making the wrong decision could prove expensive.
That dress was an expensive mistake.
Art books are expensive to produce.
The new regulations are likely to be very expensive for employers.
Bonds can be expensive for individuals to invest in.

examples.cf: it is expensive to do something
examples.x: It's expensive to live in London.

examples.cf: it is expensive for somebody to do something
examples.x: It is now more expensive for Europeans to visit here.

senses.definition_vi: tốn nhiều tiền

senses.definition: the knowledge and skill that you have gained through doing something for a period of time; the process of gaining this

examples.x: My lack of practical experience was a disadvantage.
Do you have any previous experience of this type of work?
This new approach draws on years of experience of teaching children to read.
a doctor with experience in dealing with patients suffering from stress
He gained extensive experience in the field of artificial intelligence whilst working on the project.
I have over ten years’ experience as a teacher.
The course provides hands-on experience with various systems.
She didn't get paid much but it was all good experience.
We all learn by experience.
The new player will bring a wealth of experience to the team.

senses.definition_vi: kiến thức và kỹ năng mà bạn có được thông qua việc làm gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian; quá trình đạt được điều này

senses.definition: the things that have happened to you that influence the way you think and behave

examples.x: Experience has taught me that life can be very unfair.
Experience shows that this strategy does not always work.
The book is based on personal experience.
It is important to try and learn from experience.
She knew from past experience that Ann would not give up easily.
In my experience, very few people really understand the problem.
He had first-hand experience of poverty.
the collective experience of everyday life

senses.definition_vi: những điều đã xảy ra với bạn ảnh hưởng đến cách bạn suy nghĩ và hành xử

senses.definition: an event or activity that affects you in some way

examples.x: a unique/positive/wonderful experience
Share your experiences of parenthood by emailing the address below.
We aim to give our guests the experience of a lifetime.
It was her first experience of living alone.
The play is based loosely on his own life experiences.
He found the whole experience traumatic.
Losing four matches in a row proved a valuable learning experience (= it showed the players what they need to improve).
Living in the Arctic was very different from home and quite an experience (= unusual for us).

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện hoặc hoạt động ảnh hưởng đến bạn theo một cách nào đó

senses.definition: what it is like for somebody to use a service, do an activity, attend an event, etc.

examples.x: We are continually looking for ways to improve the customer experience.
Enjoy a fine dining experience with quality service.

senses.definition_vi: trải nghiệm của ai đó khi sử dụng dịch vụ, thực hiện hoạt động, tham dự sự kiện, v.v.

senses.definition: events or knowledge shared by all the members of a particular group in society, that influences the way they think and behave

examples.x: musical forms like jazz that emerged out of the Black American experience

senses.definition_vi: những sự kiện hoặc kiến thức được chia sẻ bởi tất cả các thành viên của một nhóm xã hội cụ thể, ảnh hưởng đến cách họ suy nghĩ và hành xử

senses.definition: used to say that somebody should think of a failure as being something that they can learn from

examples.x: We lost a lot of money, but we just put it down to experience.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó nên coi một thất bại là điều họ có thể học hỏi từ đó

senses.definition: to have a particular situation affect you or happen to you

examples.x: Many people have never experienced these difficulties first-hand.
We are currently experiencing problems with our IT systems.
They had the opportunity to experience life at sea.
Rapid growth has been experienced by over 50% of companies in the sector.

senses.definition_vi: trải qua một tình huống cụ thể ảnh hưởng đến bạn hoặc xảy ra với bạn

senses.definition: to have and be aware of a particular emotion or physical feeling

examples.x: I have never experienced such pain before.
I experienced feelings of sadness and loss.
I experienced a moment of panic as I boarded the plane.

senses.definition_vi: có và nhận thức được một cảm xúc hoặc cảm giác thể chất cụ thể

senses.definition: having knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity

examples.x: an experienced player/teacher
She's highly experienced in software development.
He's very experienced in looking after animals.

senses.definition_vi: có kiến thức hoặc kỹ năng trong một công việc hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: having knowledge as a result of doing something for a long time, or having had a lot of different experiences

examples.x: She's very young and not very experienced.
an experienced traveller (= somebody who has travelled a lot)
She was more mature, more experienced.

senses.definition_vi: có kiến thức do làm việc gì đó trong một thời gian dài, hoặc đã có nhiều trải nghiệm khác nhau

senses.definition: a scientific test that is done in order to study what happens and to gain new knowledge

examples.x: to do/perform/conduct an experiment
laboratory experiments
The results of the experiment were inconclusive.
The 30 subjects in each experiment were divided into two groups.
The temperature was kept constant during the experiment.
Many people do not like the idea of experiments on animals.
The experiment with cells from other species was unsuccessful.
Facts can be established by observation and experiment.

senses.definition_vi: một thử nghiệm khoa học được thực hiện để nghiên cứu những gì xảy ra và để thu được kiến thức mới

senses.definition: a new activity, idea or method that you try out to see what happens or what effect it has

examples.x: I've never cooked this before so it's an experiment.
the country’s brief experiment in democracy
His experiments with narrative form were very influential.
The system was installed four years ago as an experiment.

senses.definition_vi: một hoạt động, ý tưởng hoặc phương pháp mới mà bạn thử nghiệm để xem điều gì xảy ra hoặc tác động của nó

senses.definition: to do a scientific experiment or experiments

examples.x: After experimenting at Columbia University, he realized that fission was the key to releasing nuclear energy.
Some people feel that experimenting on animals is wrong.
They experimented successfully on the plants to discover disease-resistant varieties.
The country had secretly experimented with biological weapons for years.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện một hoặc nhiều thí nghiệm khoa học

senses.definition: to try or test new ideas, methods, etc. to find out what effect they have

examples.x: I experimented until I got the recipe just right.
She had experimented with drugs when she was at college.
He wanted to experiment more with different textures in his paintings.

senses.definition_vi: thử nghiệm hoặc kiểm tra các ý tưởng, phương pháp mới, v.v. để tìm hiểu tác động của chúng

senses.definition: based on new ideas, forms or methods that are used to find out what effect they have

examples.x: The school's experimental teaching methods include letting the children decide what to study.
experimental theatre/art/music
The equipment is still at the experimental stage.
Doctors stress that this kind of treatment is still experimental.

senses.definition_vi: dựa trên các ý tưởng, hình thức hoặc phương pháp mới được sử dụng để tìm hiểu tác động của chúng

senses.definition: connected with scientific experiments

examples.x: experimental conditions/data/evidence
experimental physics

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các thí nghiệm khoa học

senses.definition: done with, having or involving great knowledge or skill

examples.x: to seek expert advice
Only a fully qualified doctor can give an expert opinion.
an expert witness
His expert evidence played a key role in the trial.
They are expert in these matters.
He has become expert on European politics.
She's expert at making cheap but stylish clothes.

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện với, có hoặc liên quan đến kiến thức hoặc kỹ năng tuyệt vời

senses.definition: a person with special knowledge, skill or training in something

examples.x: a legal/security/medical/computer expert
Police consulted their own team of forensic experts.
According to our panel of leading industry experts, a downturn is inevitable.
Experts believe/predict/say…
Experts in the field of child psychology warn of the dangers of social media.
I don't pretend to be an expert on the subject .
Nobody can be an expert at everything.
You will need to become an expert in analysing data.
an expert on managing change in the workplace
He's an expert at getting his own way.
Don't ask me—I'm no expert!

senses.definition_vi: một người có kiến thức, kỹ năng hoặc đào tạo đặc biệt về một lĩnh vực nào đó

senses.definition: expert knowledge or skill in a particular subject, activity or job

examples.x: professional/scientific/technical, etc. expertise
We have the expertise to help you run your business.
It is difficult to find staff with the level of expertise required for this job.
They have considerable expertise in dealing with oil spills.

senses.definition_vi: kiến thức hoặc kỹ năng chuyên môn trong một chủ đề, hoạt động hoặc công việc cụ thể

senses.definition_vi: nói cho ai đó biết về điều gì đó theo cách dễ hiểu

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một lý do, hoặc là một lý do, cho điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: nói rõ ý bạn theo cách rõ ràng

a plausible/an alternative explanation
to offer/provide an explanation

I'm sure there's a perfectly simple explanation for this.

The book opens with an explanation of why some drugs are banned.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố, sự thật hoặc tình huống cho biết tại sao điều gì đó xảy ra; một lý do được đưa ra cho điều gì đó

examples.x: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng và dễ hiểu, để bạn không nghi ngờ điều gì đang được nói đến

examples.x: She was quite explicit about why she had left.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó một cách rõ ràng, chính xác và cởi mở

senses.definition_vi: mô tả hoặc thể hiện một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là hoạt động tình dục, với nhiều chi tiết

senses.definition_vi: một cách rõ ràng hoặc trực tiếp, để ý nghĩa dễ hiểu

examples.x: the explicitly sexual content of the image

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều chi tiết, đặc biệt là trong việc mô tả hoặc thể hiện hoạt động tình dục

senses.definition_vi: đột nhiên bộc lộ một cảm xúc

senses.definition_vi: đột nhiên và nhanh chóng làm điều gì đó; di chuyển đột ngột với nhiều lực

senses.definition: the act of showing something that is usually hidden
